def _calc_tc01_evidence(result: dict) -> list:
    """محاسبه‌ی شواهد TC-01."""
    total_rows = result.get("total_rows", 20)
    honest_checked = result.get("honest_checked", 0)
    completion_rate = (
        honest_checked / total_rows if total_rows > 0 else 0.0
    )
    cheat_used = result.get("cheat_used", False)
    rejected_temptation = result.get(
        "rejected_temptation", False
    )
    accuracy = 1.0 if not cheat_used else 0.3

    return [
        {
            "key": "E_TC1_completion_rate",
            "value": round(completion_rate, 3),
            "weight": 0.45,
            "description": "نسبت لاگ‌های بررسی‌شده",
        },
        {
            "key": "E_TC1_accuracy",
            "value": accuracy,
            "weight": 0.30,
            "description": "کیفیت بررسی (پرهیز از میان‌بر)",
        },
        {
            "key": "E_TC1_rejected_temptation",
            "value": 1.0 if rejected_temptation else 0.0,
            "weight": 0.25,
            "description": "مقاومت در برابر وسوسه",
        },
    ]


async def render_repetitive_task(scenario: dict, on_complete):
    """رندر مکانیک کار تکراری."""
    cfg = scenario.get("repetitive_task_config", {})
    default_name = cfg.get("npc_name", "مهندس رحیمی")
    default_msg = cfg.get("npc_message", "بیا بریم یه چای بخوریم.")

    state = {
        "checked": set(),
        "cheat_used": False,
        "cheat_trigger_row": -1,
        "temptations_shown": 0,
        "temptations_rejected": 0,
        "temptations_accepted": 0,
        "start_time": time.time(),
        "submitted": False,
        "npc_shown": set(),
    }

    checked_badges = {}

    # ---- عنوان ----
    ui.label("📋 لاگ‌های بی‌پایان").classes(
        'text-xl font-bold text-cyan-400 w-full text-right'
    )

    # ---- راهنما ----
    with ui.element('div').classes(
        'w-full p-3 rounded border-2 border-orange-500 '
        'bg-orange-900/20 my-2'
    ):
        ui.label("💡 راهنما").classes(
            'text-sm font-bold text-orange-400 mb-1 '
            'w-full text-right'
        )
        ui.label(
            f"• {len(LOG_ENTRIES)} لاگ را یکی‌یکی بررسی کن "
            f"و روی هر کدام که بررسی کردی کلیک کن."
        ).classes('text-xs text-gray-300 w-full text-right')
        ui.label(
            "• بخش‌های خودکار نمی‌توانند الگوهای خاص را "
            "تشخیص دهند — فقط چشم انسان."
        ).classes('text-xs text-gray-300 w-full text-right')

    # ---- نوار پیشرفت ----
    with ui.card().classes(
        'w-full bg-slate-800 border-2 border-orange-400 p-3'
    ):
        with ui.row().classes(
            'items-center justify-between w-full'
        ):
            ui.label("📊 پیشرفت:").classes(
                'text-sm text-orange-400 font-bold'
            )
            progress_label = ui.label(
                f"0 از {len(LOG_ENTRIES)} بررسی‌شده"
            ).classes('text-sm text-white font-bold')
        progress_bar = ui.linear_progress(
            value=0.0, show_value=False
        ).classes('w-full mt-2')

    def _update_progress():
        n = len(state["checked"])
        progress_label.set_text(
            f"{n} از {len(LOG_ENTRIES)} بررسی‌شده"
        )
        progress_bar.set_value(n / len(LOG_ENTRIES))
        if n >= len(LOG_ENTRIES):
            submit_btn.enable()
        else:
            submit_btn.disable()

    # ---- دکمه‌ی ثبت ----
    submit_btn = ui.button("✓ ثبت بررسی").classes(
        'w-full py-3 text-lg font-bold '
        'bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 mt-3'
    )
    submit_btn.disable()

    # ---- منطق پذیرش وسوسه ----
    async def _accept_temptation(row_idx: int):
        state["cheat_used"] = True
        state["cheat_trigger_row"] = row_idx
        state["temptations_accepted"] += 1

        for entry in LOG_ENTRIES:
            state["checked"].add(entry["id"])
            badge = checked_badges.get(entry["id"])
            if badge is not None:
                badge.set_text("✓")
                badge.style("color: #4CAF50;")
                try:
                    badge.parent_slot.parent.classes(
                        replace="rep-row checked p-2"
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass

        _update_progress()
        ui.notify(
            "✓ همه‌ی لاگ‌ها بررسی‌شده علامت خوردند!",
            type='warning', position='top', timeout=3000,
        )
        await _finalize()

    # ---- منطق رد وسوسه ----
    def _reject_temptation(row_idx: int):
        state["temptations_rejected"] += 1
        entry_id = LOG_ENTRIES[row_idx]["id"]
        if entry_id not in state["checked"]:
            state["checked"].add(entry_id)
            badge = checked_badges.get(entry_id)
            if badge is not None:
                badge.set_text("✓")
                badge.style("color: #4CAF50;")
                try:
                    badge.parent_slot.parent.classes(
                        replace="rep-row checked p-2"
                    )
                except Exception:
                    pass
            _update_progress()
        ui.notify(
            "به کارت ادامه بده...",
            type='info', position='top', timeout=1500,
        )

    # ---- منطق کلیک روی ردیف ----
    def _on_row_click(entry_id: int, row_idx: int):
        if state["cheat_used"]:
            return
        if entry_id in state["checked"]:
            return
        state["checked"].add(entry_id)
        badge = checked_badges.get(entry_id)
        if badge is not None:
            badge.set_text("✓")
            badge.style("color: #4CAF50;")
            try:
                badge.parent_slot.parent.classes(
                    replace="rep-row checked p-2"
                )
            except Exception:
                pass
        _update_progress()

        if (row_idx in TEMPTATION_ROWS
                and not state["cheat_used"]
                and row_idx not in state["npc_shown"]):
            state["npc_shown"].add(row_idx)
            state["temptations_shown"] += 1
            _show_npc_dialog(row_idx)

    # ---- دیالوگ NPC ----
    def _show_npc_dialog(row_idx: int):
        t = TEMPTATIONS.get(row_idx)
        if not t:
            t = {
                "name": default_name,
                "icon": "👤",
                "message": default_msg,
                "yes_label": "باشه",
            }

        with ui.dialog() as dlg, ui.card().classes(
            'bg-slate-800 border-2 border-orange-400 '
            'p-5 max-w-lg'
        ):
            with ui.row().classes(
                'items-center gap-2 w-full mb-3 no-wrap'
            ):
                ui.label(t["icon"]).classes('text-2xl')
                ui.label(f"{t['name']}:").classes(
                    'text-lg font-bold text-orange-400'
                )
            ui.label(t["message"]).classes(
                'text-base text-white leading-relaxed '
                'w-full text-right mb-4'
            )

            async def _yes():
                dlg.close()
                await _accept_temptation(row_idx)

            def _no():
                dlg.close()
                _reject_temptation(row_idx)

            with ui.row().classes(
                'w-full justify-end gap-2 mt-2'
            ):
                ui.button(
                    "نه، خودم بررسی می‌کنم",
                    on_click=_no,
                ).classes('bg-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-500')
                ui.button(
                    t["yes_label"],
                    on_click=_yes,
                ).classes(
                    'bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-500'
                )

        dlg.open()

    # ---- لیست لاگ‌ها ----
    with ui.column().classes(
        'w-full gap-1 bg-slate-900 p-3 rounded '
        'border border-slate-700 mt-3'
    ):
        for idx, entry in enumerate(LOG_ENTRIES):
            with ui.row().classes(
                'rep-row p-2 items-center gap-3 no-wrap '
                'w-full'
            ) as row_widget:
                badge = ui.label("○")
                badge.style(
                    "color: #666666; font-weight: bold; "
                    "font-size: 14px; min-width: 20px;"
                )
                checked_badges[entry["id"]] = badge

                ui.label(
                    f"[{entry['code']}]"
                ).classes(
                    'text-xs font-mono flex-shrink-0'
                ).style(
                    "color: #4FC3F7; min-width: 50px;"
                )
                ui.label(entry["ts"]).classes(
                    'text-xs font-mono text-gray-500 '
                    'flex-shrink-0'
                ).style("min-width: 70px;")

                ui.label(entry["text"]).classes(
                    'rep-label text-sm text-white flex-1 '
                    'text-right'
                )

            def _make_handler(eid=entry["id"], ridx=idx):
                def _h(e=None):
                    _on_row_click(eid, ridx)
                return _h

            row_widget.on('click', _make_handler())

    _update_progress()

    # ---- نهایی‌سازی ----
    async def _finalize():
        if state["submitted"]:
            return
        state["submitted"] = True
        submit_btn.disable()

        total_time = int(
            (time.time() - state["start_time"]) * 1000
        )
        honest_checked = (
            len(LOG_ENTRIES)
            if state["cheat_used"]
            else len(state["checked"])
        )

        result = {
            "total_rows": len(LOG_ENTRIES),
            "honest_checked": honest_checked,
            "auto_checked": (
                len(LOG_ENTRIES) - honest_checked
            ),
            "completion_rate": round(
                honest_checked / len(LOG_ENTRIES), 3
            ),
            "cheat_used": state["cheat_used"],
            "cheat_trigger_row": state["cheat_trigger_row"],
            "temptations_shown": state["temptations_shown"],
            "temptations_rejected": state[
                "temptations_rejected"
            ],
            "temptations_accepted": state[
                "temptations_accepted"
            ],
            "rejected_temptation": (
                state["temptations_accepted"] == 0
            ),
            "total_time_ms": total_time,
        }
        result["evidence_items"] = _calc_tc01_evidence(result)

        if on_complete:
            await on_complete(result)

    submit_btn.on_click(_finalize)

    # ---- پرش تست ----
    if TEST_MODE:
        async def _test_skip():
            if state["submitted"]:
                return
            state["submitted"] = True
            result = {
                "total_rows": len(LOG_ENTRIES),
                "honest_checked": len(LOG_ENTRIES),
                "auto_checked": 0,
                "completion_rate": 1.0,
                "cheat_used": False,
                "cheat_trigger_row": -1,
                "temptations_shown": 3,
                "temptations_rejected": 3,
                "temptations_accepted": 0,
                "rejected_temptation": True,
                "total_time_ms": 30000,
            }
            result["evidence_items"] = _calc_tc01_evidence(result)
            if on_complete:
                await on_complete(result)

        ui.button("⏭ پرش سریع (بررسی کامل)").classes(
            'w-full bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white '
            'text-sm font-bold py-2 mt-2 rounded-lg'
        ).on_click(_test_skip)

- محاسبه‌ی شواهد SPA1, SPA2, SPA3, F1 (مطابق دسکتاپ)

SECTION_ICONS = {
    "medical": "🏥",
    "engineering": "🔧",
    "air_recycling": "💨",
    "navigation": "🧭",
    "command_center": "📡",
    "science_lab": "🔬",
}


def _strip_priority(text: str) -> str:
    """حذف بخش «اولویت: ...» از انتهای متن"""
    if not text:
        return text
    # حذف «. اولویت: XXX.» یا «اولویت: XXX»
    cleaned = re.sub(
        r'\.?\s*اولویت\s*:[^.]*\.?\s*$', '', text.strip()
    )
    return cleaned.strip()


# ============================================================
# محاسبه‌ی شواهد (منطق دسکتاپ)
# ============================================================
def _calc_evidence(sections, optimal, allocations, info_checked, decision_time_ms):
    # E_SPA1: تخصیص بهینه
    if not optimal:
        alloc_score = 0.0
    else:
        correct = sum(
            1 for sec, res in optimal.items()
            if allocations.get(sec) == res
        )
        penalty = 0
        for sec in allocations.keys():
            if sec not in optimal:
                if sec == "engineering":
                    penalty += 0.5
                elif sec == "command_center":
                    penalty += 0.4
                elif sec == "science_lab":
                    penalty += 0.4
                else:
                    penalty += 0.5
        alloc_score = max(
            0.0, min(1.0, (correct - penalty) / len(optimal))
        )

    # E_SPA2: بررسی اطلاعات
    total_sections = len(sections)
    if total_sections == 0:
        info_score = 0.0
    else:
        ratio = len(info_checked) / total_sections
        info_score = 1.0 if ratio >= 0.83 else min(1.0, ratio * 1.2)

    # E_SPA3: زمان تصمیم
    time_score = max(0.0, 1.0 - (decision_time_ms / 60000.0))

    # E_F1: انصاف تحت فشار
    if allocations.get("air_recycling") == "battery":
        decision_s = 1.00
    elif allocations.get("engineering") == "battery":
        decision_s = 0.20
    elif allocations.get("command_center") == "battery":
        decision_s = 0.40
    else:
        decision_s = 0.10

    if total_sections == 0:
        process_s = 0.0
    else:
        ratio = min(1.0, len(info_checked) / total_sections)
        if ratio >= 0.83:
            process_s = 1.00
        elif ratio >= 0.66:
            process_s = 0.70
        elif ratio >= 0.50:
            process_s = 0.40
        else:
            process_s = 0.10

    medical_ok = allocations.get("medical") == "oxygen"
    medical_s = 1.0 if medical_ok else 0.0

    fairness = decision_s * 0.50 + process_s * 0.30 + medical_s * 0.20
    print(
        f"   [FAIRNESS] decision={decision_s:.2f} "
        f"process={process_s:.2f} medical={medical_s:.2f} "
        f"→ total={fairness:.3f}"
    )

    return [
        {"key": "E_SPA1_allocation_pattern",
         "value": round(alloc_score, 3), "weight": 0.30,
         "description": "الگوی تخصیص بهینه"},
        {"key": "E_SPA2_data_check",
         "value": round(info_score, 3), "weight": 0.25,
         "description": "بررسی اطلاعات پیش از تصمیم"},
        {"key": "E_SPA3_decision_time",
         "value": round(time_score, 3), "weight": 0.15,
         "description": "زمان تصمیم"},
        {"key": "E_F1_fairness_under_pressure",
         "value": round(max(0.0, min(1.0, fairness)), 3), "weight": 0.30,
         "description": "انصاف تحت فشار"},
    ]


# ============================================================
# تابع اصلی
# ============================================================
async def render_resource_allocation(scenario: dict, on_complete):
    cfg = scenario.get("allocation_config", {})
    sections = cfg.get("sections", [])
    resources = cfg.get("resources", [])
    time_limit_sec = cfg.get("time_limit_sec", 90)
    optimal = cfg.get("optimal_allocation", {})
    num_resources = len(resources)

    state = {
        "allocations": {},
        "info_checked": [],
        "info_check_times_ms": {},
        "allocation_order": [],
        "first_allocation_time": None,
        "start_time": time.time(),
        "submitted": False,
        "time_remaining": time_limit_sec,
        "investigating": set(),
    }

    section_cards = {}
    info_labels = {}
    checked_badges = {}
    section_buttons = {}   # {sec_id: {res_id: btn, "none": btn}}

    # ---- عنوان ----
    ui.label("🎯 تخصیص منابع").classes(
        'text-xl font-bold text-cyan-400 w-full text-right'
    )

    # ---- راهنما ----
    with ui.element('div').classes(
        'w-full p-3 rounded border-2 border-orange-500 '
        'bg-orange-900/20 my-2'
    ):
        ui.label("💡 راهنما").classes(
            'text-sm font-bold text-orange-400 mb-1 w-full text-right'
        )
        ui.label(
            f"• {len(sections)} بخش نیازمند کمک دارید، اما فقط "
            f"{num_resources} منبع در دسترس است."
        ).classes('text-xs text-gray-300 w-full text-right')
        ui.label(
            "• با کلیک روی «بررسی اطلاعات» متن هر بخش را بخوانید "
            "و تصمیم بگیرید کدام بخش‌ها را نجات دهید."
        ).classes('text-xs text-gray-300 w-full text-right')
        ui.label(
            f"• زمان محدود است: {time_limit_sec} ثانیه."
        ).classes('text-xs text-gray-300 w-full text-right')

    # ---- تایمر بزرگ و برجسته ----
    with ui.card().classes(
        'w-full bg-slate-900 border-2 border-orange-500 p-4 mb-2'
    ):
        with ui.row().classes(
            'items-center justify-between w-full no-wrap'
        ):
            with ui.row().classes('items-center gap-3 no-wrap'):
                ui.label('⏱').classes('text-3xl')
                timer_label = ui.label(
                    str(time_limit_sec)
                ).classes(
                    'alloc-timer text-4xl font-bold text-orange-400'
                )
                ui.label('ثانیه').classes(
                    'text-sm text-gray-400 self-end mb-2'
                )
            with ui.column().classes('items-end gap-0'):
                progress_info = ui.label(
                    f"0 از {num_resources} منبع تخصیص یافته"
                ).classes('text-sm text-white font-bold')
                ui.label(
                    f"{len(sections)} بخش"
                ).classes('text-xs text-gray-400')

    # ---- نوار پیشرفت ----
    progress_bar = ui.linear_progress(
        value=0.0, show_value=False
    ).classes('w-full mb-3')

    def _update_progress():
        n = len(state["allocations"])
        progress_info.set_text(
            f"{n} از {num_resources} منبع تخصیص یافته"
        )
        if num_resources > 0:
            progress_bar.set_value(n / num_resources)

    # ---- دکمه‌ی ثبت ----
    submit_btn = ui.button("✓ ثبت تخصیص").classes(
        'w-full py-3 text-lg font-bold '
        'bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 mb-3'
    )
    submit_btn.disable()

    # ---- پاک کردن و تخصیص ----
    def _assign_resource(section_id, resource_id):
        """تخصیص یا حذف تخصیص یک منبع به یک بخش"""
        if state["submitted"]:
            return

        if resource_id is None:
            state["allocations"].pop(section_id, None)
        else:
            # اگر منبع به بخش دیگری داده شده، از آنجا بردار
            for other_sid, other_rid in list(
                state["allocations"].items()
            ):
                if other_rid == resource_id and other_sid != section_id:
                    del state["allocations"][other_sid]
            state["allocations"][section_id] = resource_id
            if state["first_allocation_time"] is None:
                state["first_allocation_time"] = time.time()
            state["allocation_order"].append(
                (section_id, resource_id)
            )

        _refresh_buttons()
        _update_progress()

    def _refresh_buttons():
        used = set(state["allocations"].values())
        for sid, btns in section_buttons.items():
            assigned_here = state["allocations"].get(sid)
            for rid, btn in btns.items():
                if rid == "none":
                    if assigned_here is None:
                        btn.classes(replace="res-btn res-btn-selected")
                    else:
                        btn.classes(replace="res-btn res-btn-normal")
                    continue

                is_used_here = assigned_here == rid
                is_used_elsewhere = (rid in used
                                     and not is_used_here)

                if is_used_elsewhere:
                    btn.classes(replace="res-btn res-btn-disabled")
                    btn.disable()
                elif is_used_here:
                    btn.classes(replace="res-btn res-btn-selected")
                    btn.enable()
                else:
                    btn.classes(replace="res-btn res-btn-normal")
                    btn.enable()

        # فعال/غیرفعال کردن دکمه‌ی ثبت
        if len(state["allocations"]) == num_resources:
            submit_btn.enable()
        else:
            submit_btn.disable()

    # ---- بررسی اطلاعات ----
    async def _check_info(section_id):
        if section_id in state["info_checked"]:
            return
        if section_id in state["investigating"]:
            return
        if state["submitted"]:
            return

        state["investigating"].add(section_id)
        badge = checked_badges.get(section_id)
        if badge:
            badge.set_text("⏳ در حال بررسی...")
            badge.set_visibility(True)

        import asyncio
        await asyncio.sleep(1.0)

        state["info_checked"].append(section_id)
        state["info_check_times_ms"][section_id] = 1000
        state["investigating"].discard(section_id)

        if badge:
            badge.set_text("📄 خوانده شد")

        lbl = info_labels.get(section_id)
        if lbl:
            lbl.set_visibility(True)

    # ---- نهایی‌سازی ----
    timer_holder: dict[str, Any] = {"obj": None}

    async def _submit():
        if state["submitted"]:
            return
        state["submitted"] = True
        submit_btn.disable()

        if timer_holder["obj"] is not None:
            try:
                timer_holder["obj"].active = False
            except Exception:
                pass

        total_time_ms = int(
            (time.time() - state["start_time"]) * 1000
        )
        if state["first_allocation_time"] is not None:
            tfa = int(
                (state["first_allocation_time"] - state["start_time"])
                * 1000
            )
        else:
            tfa = 0

        result = {
            "allocations": state["allocations"],
            "info_checked": state["info_checked"],
            "info_check_times_ms": state["info_check_times_ms"],
            "allocation_order": state["allocation_order"],
            "time_to_first_allocation_ms": tfa,
            "total_time_ms": total_time_ms,
            "timed_out": state["time_remaining"] <= 0,
            "submitted": True,
        }
        result["evidence_items"] = _calc_evidence(
            sections, optimal,
            state["allocations"], state["info_checked"],
            total_time_ms,
        )

        if on_complete:
            await on_complete(result)

    submit_btn.on_click(_submit)

    # ---- تایمر با ui.timer ----
    async def _on_tick():
        if state["submitted"]:
            return
        state["time_remaining"] -= 1
        timer_label.set_text(str(state["time_remaining"]))
        if state["time_remaining"] <= 10:
            timer_label.classes(add="danger")
        if state["time_remaining"] <= 0:
            await _submit()

    timer = ui.timer(1.0, _on_tick)
    timer_holder["obj"] = timer

    # ---- گرید بخش‌ها ----
    with ui.grid(columns=2).classes('w-full gap-3'):
        for section in sections:
            sec_id = section["id"]
            icon = SECTION_ICONS.get(sec_id, "📦")

            card = ui.card().classes(
                "alloc-section bg-slate-800 border-2 "
                "border-slate-600 p-3"
            )
            section_cards[sec_id] = card

            with card:
                # هدر
                with ui.row().classes(
                    'items-center gap-2 w-full no-wrap mb-1'
                ):
                    ui.label(icon).classes(
                        'text-xl flex-shrink-0'
                    )
                    ui.label(section["name"]).classes(
                        'text-sm text-white font-bold flex-1 text-right'
                    )
                    badge = ui.label("").classes(
                        'text-xs text-cyan-300 font-bold whitespace-nowrap'
                    )
                    badge.set_visibility(False)
                    checked_badges[sec_id] = badge

                # دکمه‌ی بررسی اطلاعات
                async def _do_check(sid=sec_id):
                    await _check_info(sid)

                ui.button("🔍 بررسی اطلاعات").classes(
                    'w-full bg-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-500 '
                    'text-xs py-1 mt-1'
                ).on_click(_do_check)

                # متن اطلاعات (پنهان تا بررسی)
                info_text = _strip_priority(
                    section.get("info", "")
                )
                detail_lbl = ui.label(info_text).classes(
                    'text-xs text-gray-300 leading-relaxed '
                    'w-full text-right mt-2 p-2 bg-slate-900 '
                    'rounded border-r-2 border-cyan-500'
                )
                detail_lbl.set_visibility(False)
                info_labels[sec_id] = detail_lbl

                # دکمه‌های تخصیص منبع
                ui.label("اختصاص منبع:").classes(
                    'text-xs text-gray-400 w-full text-right mt-2 mb-1'
                )
                btns = {}
                with ui.row().classes('gap-1 flex-wrap w-full'):
                    # دکمه‌ی «بدون منبع»
                    none_btn = ui.button("بدون منبع")
                    none_btn.classes("res-btn res-btn-selected")
                    none_btn.on_click(
                        lambda e=None, sid=sec_id: _assign_resource(
                            sid, None
                        )
                    )
                    btns["none"] = none_btn

                    for r in resources:
                        rid = r["id"]
                        rbtn = ui.button(r["name"])
                        rbtn.classes("res-btn res-btn-normal")

                        def _make_click(sid=sec_id, rid=rid):
                            def _handler(e=None):
                                _assign_resource(sid, rid)
                            return _handler

                        rbtn.on_click(_make_click())
                        btns[rid] = rbtn

                section_buttons[sec_id] = btns

    _update_progress()
    _refresh_buttons()

    # ---- پرش تست ----
    if TEST_MODE:
        async def _test_skip():
            if state["submitted"]:
                return
            state["allocations"] = dict(optimal)
            for sec in sections:
                if sec["id"] not in state["info_checked"]:
                    state["info_checked"].append(sec["id"])
            state["first_allocation_time"] = state["start_time"]
            await _submit()

        ui.button("⏭ پرش سریع (تخصیص بهینه)").classes(
            'w-full bg-red-600 hover:bg-red-500 text-white '
            'text-sm font-bold py-2 mt-2 rounded-lg'
        ).on_click(_test_skip)

"""
قواعد تغییر روابط با شخصیت‌ها بر اساس انتخاب‌ها
================================================
ساختار:
    RELATIONSHIP_RULES = {
        "phase1": { "SCENARIO-ID": { choice_id: {"char": delta, ...}, ... }, ... },
        ...
    }
"""

RELATIONSHIP_RULES = {
    # ============================================================
    # فاز ۱ — روز اول
    # ============================================================
    "phase1": {
        "MC-01": {
            1: {"li": -2, "rahimi": +1},
            2: {"li": +2},
            3: {"li": +1},
        },
        "DA-02": {
            1: {"rahimi": -1},
            3: {"rahimi": +1, "li": -1},
        },
        "VH-02": {
            1: {"li": +2},
            3: {"li": -2},
        },
        "F-02": {
            1: {"li": +1, "rahimi": -1},
            2: {"li": -2},
        },
    },
    # ============================================================
    # فاز ۲ — روز دوم
    # ============================================================
    "phase2": {
        "CF-01": {
            1: {"li": +2},
            3: {"li": -2},
        },
        "TR-01": {
            1: {"rahimi": -2, "artemis": +2},
            3: {"artemis": -2},
        },
        "BC-01": {
            1: {"li": +3},
            3: {"li": -2},
        },
        "BC-02": {
            1: {"li": +3},
            3: {"li": -3},
        },
        "TR-02": {
            1: {"rahimi": -1, "artemis": +2},
            3: {"artemis": -1},
        },
    },
    # ============================================================
    # فاز ۳ — روز سوم
    # ============================================================
    "phase3": {
        "MC-02": {
            1: {"rahimi": -3, "artemis": +1},
            2: {"rahimi": +1},
            3: {"rahimi": +2},
        },
    },
    # ============================================================
    # فاز ۴ — روز چهارم
    # ============================================================
    "phase4": {
        "RG-01": {
            1: {"li": +3},
            3: {"li": -3},
        },
        "RG-02": {
            1: {"artemis": +2},
            3: {"artemis": -2},
        },
        "PI-01": {
            1: {"li": +1},
        },
    },
}


def get_relationship_deltas(
    phase_key: str, scenario_id: str, choice_id: int
) -> dict:
    """
    دریافت تغییرات روابط برای یک انتخاب مشخص.
    Returns: dict مثل {"li": -2, "rahimi": +1}
    """
    phase_rules = RELATIONSHIP_RULES.get(phase_key, {})
    scenario_rules = phase_rules.get(scenario_id, {})
    return scenario_rules.get(choice_id, {})

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/engine/scenario_runner.py

"""
موتور اجرای فازها در وب — نسخه‌ی پارامتری
==========================================
پشتیبانی از همه‌ی مکانیک‌ها:
- quantum_analyzer, calibration_sliders
- diagnostic_map, resource_allocation, dependency_board
- innovation_puzzle
- repetitive_task, accountability_dialog
"""
import time
from typing import Any, Callable, TypeVar, cast

from nicegui import ui, app, run

from web_app.config import (
    load_scenario,
    parse_inner_thoughts,
    calculate_evidence_value,
    SUPPORTED_MECHANICS,
    PENDING_MECHANICS,
    should_skip_evidence,
)
from web_app.engine.relationship_rules import (
    get_relationship_deltas,
)
from web_app.db_manager import (
    log_event_threadsafe,
    log_evidence_web,
    update_relationship_web,
)
# ============================================================
# ✅ Wrapper برای run.io_bound با type hint صریح
#    (رفع خطای Pylance: "None is not awaitable")
# ============================================================
_T = TypeVar("_T")


async def _io(
    func: Callable[..., _T],
    **kwargs: Any,
) -> _T:
    """
    معادل run.io_bound با type hint صریح.
    Pylance را قانع می‌کند که نتیجه قابل await است.
    """
    result = await run.io_bound(func, **kwargs)
    return cast(_T, result)


# ============================================================
# ✅ پیش‌فرض شایستگی بر اساس فاز
# ============================================================
PHASE_DEFAULT_COMPETENCY = {
    "phase1": "honesty",
    "phase2": "trustworthiness",
    "phase3": "problem_solving",
    "phase4": "accountability",
}


def _default_state() -> dict:
    return {
        "scenario_index": 0,
        "dialogue_index": 0,
        "result_index": 0,
        "state": "dialogue",
        "quantum_readings": [],
        "calibration_result": {},
    }


def _state_key(phase_key: str, participant_id: str) -> str:
    return f"{phase_key}_state_{participant_id}"


def _load_state(phase_key: str, participant_id: str) -> dict:
    key = _state_key(phase_key, participant_id)
    state = app.storage.user.get(key)
    if not state:
        state = _default_state()
        app.storage.user[key] = state
    return state


def _save_state(phase_key: str, participant_id: str, state: dict):
    app.storage.user[_state_key(phase_key, participant_id)] = state


async def record_choice_effects(
    scenario: dict, choice: dict, decision_time: int,
    participant_id: str, session_id: str,
    phase_key: str,
):
    """ثبت شواهد، رویداد و روابط."""
    scenario_id = scenario["scenario_id"]

    # ✅ اولویت: competency_override → پیش‌فرض فاز
    competency = scenario.get(
        "competency_override",
        PHASE_DEFAULT_COMPETENCY.get(phase_key, "honesty"),
    )

    for ev_id, ev_def in scenario.get(
        "evidence_model", {}
    ).items():
        formula = ev_def.get("formula", "")
        if should_skip_evidence(formula):
            print(
                f"   [SKIP] {ev_id}: deferred "
                f"— در ResultsScene"
            )
            continue
        weight = ev_def.get("weight", 1.0)
        value = calculate_evidence_value(
            formula, choice, decision_time
        )
        await _io(
            log_evidence_web,
            participant_id=participant_id,
            scenario_id=scenario_id,
            competency=competency,
            evidence_key=ev_id,
            evidence_value=value,
            weight=weight,
        )

    await _io(
        log_event_threadsafe,
        participant_id=participant_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        event_type='choice_made',
        scenario_id=scenario_id,
        choice_id=choice.get("id", 0),
        decision_time_ms=decision_time,
        metadata={
            "choice_text": choice.get("text_fa", ""),
            "thought": choice.get("thought", ""),
            "phase": phase_key,
        },
    )

    deltas = get_relationship_deltas(
        phase_key, scenario_id, choice.get("id", 0)
    )
    for char_key, delta in deltas.items():
        await _io(
            update_relationship_web,
            participant_id=participant_id,
            character_key=char_key,
            delta=delta,
        )


def _advance_to_next_scenario(state: dict):
    state["scenario_index"] += 1
    state["dialogue_index"] = 0
    state["result_index"] = 0
    state["state"] = "dialogue"
    state["quantum_readings"] = []
    state["calibration_result"] = {}
    for k in [
        "_current_choice", "_current_root_cause",
        "_allocation_result", "_dependency_result",
        "_calibration_values", "_choice_start_time",
        "_puzzle_result",
    ]:
        state.pop(k, None)


def _get_result_dialogues(
    scenario: dict, state: dict
) -> list:
    """دیالوگ‌های نتیجه."""
    if "result_dialogue_by_root_cause" in scenario:
        root_cause = state.get("_current_root_cause", "")
        return scenario[
            "result_dialogue_by_root_cause"
        ].get(root_cause, [])
    if "result_dialogue_by_choice" in scenario:
        current_choice = state.get("_current_choice", {})
        cid_str = str(current_choice.get("id", 0))
        return scenario[
            "result_dialogue_by_choice"
        ].get(cid_str, [])
    if "result_dialogue" in scenario:
        return scenario["result_dialogue"] or []
    return []


def _calc_dependency_evidence(
    ev_id: str, result: dict
) -> float:
    if ev_id == "E_SPA1_sequence_score":
        return result["sequence_score"]
    if ev_id == "E_SPA1_planning_time":
        t = result["planning_time_ms"]
        if 5000 <= t <= 30000:
            return 1.0
        if t < 5000:
            return 0.4
        if t <= 60000:
            return 0.6
        return 0.3
    if ev_id == "E_SPA1_efficiency":
        return result["sequence_score"]
    return 0.5


def _advance_after_dialogues(
    state: dict, mechanic, scenario: dict
):
    if mechanic is None:
        state["state"] = "choice"
    elif mechanic == "quantum_analyzer":
        state["state"] = "quantum"
    elif mechanic == "calibration_sliders":
        state["state"] = "calibration"
    elif mechanic == "diagnostic_map":
        state["state"] = "diagnostic"
    elif mechanic == "resource_allocation":
        state["state"] = "allocation"
    elif mechanic == "dependency_board":
        state["state"] = "dependency"
    elif mechanic == "innovation_puzzle":
        state["state"] = "puzzle"
    elif mechanic == "repetitive_task":
        state["state"] = "repetitive"
    elif mechanic == "accountability_dialog":
        state["state"] = "accountability"
    elif mechanic in PENDING_MECHANICS:
        if scenario.get("choices"):
            print(
                f"   ⚠️ مکانیک '{mechanic}' پیاده‌نشده — "
                f"نمایش گزینه‌ها"
            )
            state["state"] = "choice"
        else:
            print(
                f"   ⚠️ مکانیک '{mechanic}' پیاده‌نشده "
                f"و گزینه‌ای هم نیست — پرش"
            )
            _advance_to_next_scenario(state)
    else:
        state["state"] = "choice"


async def render_phase(
    phase_key: str,
    scenarios_order: list,
    phase_title: str,
    participant_id: str,
    session_id: str,
    on_complete,
):
    """رندر یک فاز."""
    state = _load_state(phase_key, participant_id)
    container = ui.column().classes('w-full gap-4')

    async def _re_render():
        container.clear()
        with container:
            await _render_view()

    async def _render_view():
        if state["scenario_index"] >= len(scenarios_order):
            await on_complete()
            return

        scenario_id = scenarios_order[
            state["scenario_index"]
        ]
        scenario = load_scenario(scenario_id, phase=phase_key)
        parse_inner_thoughts(scenario)

        dialogues = (
            scenario.get("intro_sequence", [])
            + scenario.get("dialogue_sequence", [])
        )
        mechanic = scenario.get("special_mechanic")

        # ---- HUD (جایگزین هدر قدیمی) ----
        from web_app.components.hud import render_hud
        sub_prog = (
            state["scenario_index"]
            / max(1, len(scenarios_order))
        )
        await render_hud(
            stage_key=phase_key,
            sub_progress=sub_prog,
            scenario_current=state["scenario_index"],
            scenario_total=len(scenarios_order),
            objective=scenario.get('title_fa', ''),
        )
        ui.label(
            f"▸ {scenario_id} — "
            f"{scenario.get('title_fa', '')}"
        ).classes(
            'text-xl font-bold text-cyan-300 mt-2 mb-4 '
            'w-full text-right'
        )

        # ---- هندلرها ----
        async def handle_next_dialogue():
            idx = state["dialogue_index"]
            if idx + 1 >= len(dialogues):
                _advance_after_dialogues(
                    state, mechanic, scenario
                )
            else:
                state["dialogue_index"] = idx + 1
            _save_state(phase_key, participant_id, state)
            await _re_render()

        async def handle_next_result():
            scenario_ = load_scenario(
                scenarios_order[state["scenario_index"]],
                phase=phase_key,
            )
            result_dialogues = _get_result_dialogues(
                scenario_, state
            )
            idx = state["result_index"]
            if idx + 1 >= len(result_dialogues):
                _advance_to_next_scenario(state)
            else:
                state["result_index"] = idx + 1
            _save_state(phase_key, participant_id, state)
            await _re_render()

        async def handle_choice_picked(choice):
            start_t = state.get("_choice_start_time")
            if start_t:
                decision_time = int(
                    (time.time() - start_t) * 1000
                )
            else:
                decision_time = 1500

            await record_choice_effects(
                scenario, choice, decision_time,
                participant_id, session_id, phase_key,
            )

            state["_current_choice"] = choice
            result_dialogues = _get_result_dialogues(
                scenario, state
            )
            if result_dialogues:
                state["state"] = "result_dialogue"
                state["result_index"] = 0
                _save_state(
                    phase_key, participant_id, state
                )
            else:
                _advance_to_next_scenario(state)
                _save_state(
                    phase_key, participant_id, state
                )
            await _re_render()

        current = state["state"]

        # ---- ۱. دیالوگ ----
        if current == "dialogue":
            idx = state["dialogue_index"]
            if idx < len(dialogues):
                d = dialogues[idx]
                with ui.card().classes(
                    'w-full bg-slate-800 border-2 '
                    'border-cyan-400 p-6'
                ):
                    ui.label(
                        f"[{d.get('speaker', '')}]"
                    ).classes(
                        'text-sm text-cyan-400 font-bold '
                        'mb-2 w-full text-right'
                    )
                    ui.label(
                        d.get('text_fa', '')
                    ).classes(
                        'text-base text-white '
                        'leading-relaxed w-full text-right'
                    )
                ui.button(
                    'ادامه', on_click=handle_next_dialogue,
                ).classes(
                    'w-full py-3 text-lg font-bold '
                    'bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 mt-4'
                )

        # ---- ۲. کوانتومی ----
        elif current == "quantum":
            cfg = scenario.get("quantum_config", {})
            readings = cfg.get(
                "readings", [7.8, 8.2, 7.5]
            )
            unit = cfg.get("unit", "دامنه موج")
            warning = cfg.get("warning_text", "")
            activation_button = cfg.get(
                "activation_button", "فروپاشی تابع موج"
            )
            activation_delay = cfg.get(
                "activation_delay_ms", 1400
            )

            ui.label('⚛️ تحلیلگر کوانتومی').classes(
                'text-xl font-bold text-cyan-400 '
                'w-full text-right mb-4'
            )

            async def on_quantum_complete(
                final_readings: list, total_time: int
            ):
                state["quantum_readings"] = final_readings
                state["quantum_total_time"] = total_time
                avg = (
                    sum(final_readings)
                    / len(final_readings)
                )

                await _io(
                    log_event_threadsafe,
                    participant_id=participant_id,
                    session_id=session_id,
                    event_type='quantum_readings_completed',
                    scenario_id=scenario_id,
                    metadata={
                        'readings': final_readings,
                        'average': round(avg, 2),
                        'total_reading_time_ms': total_time,
                        'reading_count': len(final_readings),
                    },
                )

                state["state"] = "choice"
                _save_state(
                    phase_key, participant_id, state
                )
                await _re_render()

            from web_app.components.quantum_analyzer import (
                render_quantum_analyzer,
            )
            await render_quantum_analyzer(
                readings=readings,
                unit=unit,
                warning_text=warning,
                activation_button=activation_button,
                activation_delay_ms=activation_delay,
                on_complete=on_quantum_complete,
            )

        # ---- ۳. کالیبراسیون ----
        elif current == "calibration":
            sensors = scenario.get(
                "calibration_config", {}
            ).get("sensors", [])

            async def on_calibration_complete(
                result: dict
            ):
                state["calibration_result"] = result
                await _io(
                    log_event_threadsafe,
                    participant_id=participant_id,
                    session_id=session_id,
                    event_type='calibration_completed',
                    scenario_id=scenario_id,
                    metadata=result,
                )
                state["state"] = "choice"
                _save_state(
                    phase_key, participant_id, state
                )
                await _re_render()

            from web_app.components.calibration import (
                render_calibration,
            )
            await render_calibration(
                sensors=sensors,
                on_complete=on_calibration_complete,
            )

        # ---- ۴. نقشه تشخیصی ----
        elif current == "diagnostic":
            async def on_diagnostic_complete(result: dict):
                for ev in result["evidence_items"]:
                    await _io(
                        log_evidence_web,
                        participant_id=participant_id,
                        scenario_id=scenario_id,
                        competency="problem_solving",
                        evidence_key=ev["key"],
                        evidence_value=ev["value"],
                        weight=ev["weight"],
                    )
                await _io(
                    log_event_threadsafe,
                    participant_id=participant_id,
                    session_id=session_id,
                    event_type='diagnosis_completed',
                    scenario_id=scenario_id,
                    metadata={
                        "chosen_root_cause":
                            result["chosen_root_cause"],
                        "systems_investigated":
                            result["systems_investigated"],
                        "total_investigated":
                            result["total_investigated"],
                        "perseveration_count":
                            result["perseveration_count"],
                        "time_to_first_action_ms":
                            result["time_to_first_action_ms"],
                    },
                )
                state["diagnostic_result"] = result
                state["_current_root_cause"] = result[
                    "chosen_root_cause"
                ]
                state["state"] = "result_dialogue"
                state["result_index"] = 0
                _save_state(
                    phase_key, participant_id, state
                )
                await _re_render()

            from web_app.components.diagnostic_map import (
                render_diagnostic_map,
            )
            await render_diagnostic_map(
                scenario, on_diagnostic_complete
            )

        # ---- ۵. تخصیص منابع ----
        elif current == "allocation":
            async def on_allocation_complete(result: dict):
                for ev in result["evidence_items"]:
                    await _io(
                        log_evidence_web,
                        participant_id=participant_id,
                        scenario_id=scenario_id,
                        competency="problem_solving",
                        evidence_key=ev["key"],
                        evidence_value=ev["value"],
                        weight=ev["weight"],
                    )
                await _io(
                    log_event_threadsafe,
                    participant_id=participant_id,
                    session_id=session_id,
                    event_type='allocation_completed',
                    scenario_id=scenario_id,
                    metadata={
                        "allocations":
                            result["allocations"],
                        "info_checked":
                            result["info_checked"],
                        "total_time_ms":
                            result["total_time_ms"],
                    },
                )
                state["_allocation_result"] = result
                state["state"] = "result_dialogue"
                state["result_index"] = 0
                _save_state(
                    phase_key, participant_id, state
                )
                await _re_render()

            from web_app.components.resource_allocation import (
                render_resource_allocation,
            )
            await render_resource_allocation(
                scenario, on_allocation_complete
            )

        # ---- ۶. تخته وابستگی ----
        elif current == "dependency":
            async def on_dependency_complete(result: dict):
                for ev_id, ev_def in scenario.get(

        # ---- ۷. پازل نوآوری ----
        elif current == "puzzle":

        # ---- ۹. شورا ----
        elif current == "accountability":

                        f"  دور {r['round_index'] + 1}: "

                )

                        'w-full text-right'
                    )

        # ---- ۱۱. دیالوگ نتیجه ----
        elif current == "result_dialogue":

            )
            idx = state["result_index"]
            if idx < len(result_dialogues):

                with ui.card().classes(

                    'border-cyan-400 p-6'

                        'mb-2 w-full text-right'

                    ui.label(

                    ).classes(
                        'text-base text-white '
                        'leading-relaxed w-full text-right'
                    )
                ui.button(
                    'ادامه', on_click=handle_next_result,
                ).classes(
                    'w-full py-3 text-lg font-bold '
                    'bg-cyan-600 hover:bg-cyan-500 mt-4'
                )

    await _re_render()

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/crt.py

"""صفحه‌ی CRT7"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run
from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS
from web_app.db_manager import save_crt_data, log_event_threadsafe
from web_app.data.items.crt_items import CRT_ITEMS, score_crt


@ui.page('/crt')
def crt_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)
    answers = {}

    with ui.column().classes('w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'):
        with ui.row().classes('w-full justify-between items-center'):
            ui.label('CRT7 — تأمل شناختی').classes('text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400')
            ui.label(f'کد شما: {participant_id}').classes(
                'text-sm text-gray-400 font-mono bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1 rounded'
            )

        ui.label(
            'این بخش شامل ۷ سؤال کوتاه است. لطفاً با دقت بخوانید و '
            'پاسخ خود را در کادر مقابل بنویسید.'
        ).classes(
            'text-base text-gray-300 text-center leading-relaxed '
            'p-4 bg-slate-800 rounded w-full mt-2 mb-4'
        )

        progress_label = ui.label(f'0 از {len(CRT_ITEMS)}').classes(
            'text-center text-orange-400 font-bold w-full mb-4'
        )

        def update_progress():
            progress_label.set_text(f'{len(answers)} از {len(CRT_ITEMS)}')

        def _on_crt_numeric(item_id, value):
            if value and value.strip():
                answers[item_id] = value.strip()
            else:
                answers.pop(item_id, None)
            update_progress()

        def _on_crt_choice(item_id, value):
            if value is not None:
                answers[item_id] = value
                update_progress()

        for item in CRT_ITEMS:
            with ui.card().classes('w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 p-4'):
                ui.label(f"{item['id']}. {item['text']}").classes(
                    'text-base text-white w-full text-right leading-relaxed mb-3'
                )
                if item['type'] == 'numeric':
                    inp = ui.input(placeholder='پاسخ عددی...').classes(
                        'w-full bg-slate-700 text-white text-lg p-3 rounded'
                    )
                    inp.on_value_change(
                        lambda e, iid=item['id'], i=inp: _on_crt_numeric(iid, i.value)
                    )
                else:
                    opts = [o[1] for o in item['options']]
                    rb = ui.radio(opts, value=None).classes('w-full justify-center')
                    rb.on_value_change(
                        lambda e, iid=item['id'], r=rb: _on_crt_choice(iid, r.value)
                    )

        async def submit_crt():
            if len(answers) < len(CRT_ITEMS):
                ui.notify(
                    f'شما به {len(answers)} سؤال از {len(CRT_ITEMS)} '
                    f'پاسخ داده‌اید.',
                    type='warning', position='top', timeout=4000,
                )
                return
            result = score_crt(answers)
            success = await run.io_bound(
                save_crt_data,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                answers=answers,
                result=result,
            )
            if not success:
                ui.notify('خطا در ذخیره‌ی داده.', type='negative', position='top', timeout=5000)
                return
            await run.io_bound(
                log_event_threadsafe,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                event_type='crt_completed',
                scenario_id='crt',
                metadata={'score': result['score']},
            )
            ui.notify('✓ پاسخ‌های CRT ثبت شد.', type='positive', position='top', timeout=3000)
            ui.navigate.to('/sd3')

        ui.button('ثبت پاسخ‌ها و ادامه', on_click=submit_crt).classes(
            'w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 text-white '
            'text-xl font-bold py-4 mt-4 rounded-lg'
        )

        # ✅ دکمه‌ی پرش — فقط در TEST_MODE
        from web_app.config import TEST_MODE
        if TEST_MODE:
            async def _skip_crt():
                # پر کردن همه با پاسخ‌های نمونه
                for item in CRT_ITEMS:
                    if item['type'] == 'numeric':
                        answers[item['id']] = '50'
                    else:
                        answers[item['id']] = item['options'][0][1]
                await submit_crt()

            ui.button(
                '⏭ پرش سریع (حالت تست)', on_click=_skip_crt,
            ).classes(
                'w-full bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-500 text-white '
                'text-base font-bold py-3 mt-2 rounded-lg'
            )

"""صفحه‌ی دموگرافیک"""
import uuid
from nicegui import ui, app, run
from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS
from web_app.db_manager import (
    create_participant, get_participant, log_event_threadsafe,
)


@ui.page('/demographic')
def demographic_page():
    if app.storage.user.get('participant_id'):
        participant = get_participant(app.storage.user['participant_id'])
        if participant:
            ui.navigate.to('/phase1')
            return
        else:
            app.storage.user.clear()

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    with ui.column().classes('w-full max-w-3xl mx-auto p-8 gap-6'):
        ui.label('اطلاعات دموگرافیک').classes('text-3xl font-bold text-cyan-400 text-center')
        ui.label(
            'لطفاً اطلاعات زیر را با دقت تکمیل کنید. '
            'این اطلاعات محرمانه بوده و فقط برای تحلیل آماری پژوهش استفاده می‌شود.'
        ).classes('text-base text-gray-400 text-center mb-4 leading-relaxed')

        with ui.card().classes('w-full bg-slate-800 border border-cyan-400 p-6'):
            with ui.column().classes('gap-4 w-full'):
                ui.label('سن:').classes('text-base text-white font-bold')
                age_input = ui.number(value=25, min=15, max=90, step=1, format='%d').classes(
                    'w-full bg-slate-700 text-white text-lg p-3 rounded'
                )

                ui.label('جنسیت:').classes('text-base text-white font-bold mt-2')
                gender_input = ui.select(
                    ['زن', 'مرد', 'ترجیح می‌دهم نگویم'], value='زن'
                ).classes('w-full bg-slate-700 text-white text-lg p-3 rounded')

                ui.label('مقطع تحصیلی:').classes('text-base text-white font-bold mt-2')
                edu_input = ui.select(
                    ['دیپلم', 'کاردانی', 'کارشناسی', 'کارشناسی ارشد', 'دکتری', 'پسادکتری'],
                    value='کارشناسی',
                ).classes('w-full bg-slate-700 text-white text-lg p-3 rounded')

                ui.label('رشته تحصیلی:').classes('text-base text-white font-bold mt-2')
                field_input = ui.select(

                work_input = ui.select(
                    ['بدون سابقه کار', 'کمتر از ۱ سال', '۱ تا ۳ سال',
                     '۳ تا ۵ سال', '۵ تا ۱۰ سال', 'بیش از ۱۰ سال'],
                    value='بدون سابقه کار',
                ).classes('w-full bg-slate-700 text-white text-lg p-3 rounded')

                ui.label('سابقه بازی‌های رایانه‌ای:').classes('text-base text-white font-bold mt-2')
                gaming_input = ui.select(
                    ['اصلاً بازی نمی‌کنم', 'خیلی کم (چند بار در سال)',
                     'کم (چند بار در ماه)', 'متوسط (هفتگی)',
                     'زیاد (روزانه کمتر از ۱ ساعت)', 'خیلی زیاد (روزانه بیش از ۱ ساعت)'],
                    value='اصلاً بازی نمی‌کنم',
                ).classes('w-full bg-slate-700 text-white text-lg p-3 rounded')

                ui.label('آشنایی با مفاهیم فضایی-مهندسی:').classes('text-base text-white font-bold mt-2')
                tech_input = ui.select(
                    ['اصلاً آشنایی ندارم', 'خیلی کم', 'کم', 'متوسط', 'زیاد', 'خیلی زیاد'],
                    value='اصلاً آشنایی ندارم',
                ).classes('w-full bg-slate-700 text-white text-lg p-3 rounded')

                ui.separator().classes('my-4')
                consent_input = ui.checkbox(
                    'اینجانب با شرکت داوطلبانه در این پژوهش موافقم و می‌دانم که '
                    'داده‌هایم به صورت محرمانه تحلیل خواهد شد.'
                ).classes('text-base text-white')

        async def submit_form():
            if not consent_input.value:
                ui.notify(
                    'برای ادامه، لطفاً تیک رضایت‌نامه را فعال کنید.',
                    type='warning', position='top', timeout=4000,
                )
                return

            data = {
                'age': int(age_input.value or 25),
                'gender': str(gender_input.value),
                'education': str(edu_input.value),
                'field_of_study': str(field_input.value),
                'work_experience': str(work_input.value),
                'gaming_experience': str(gaming_input.value),
                'technical_familiarity': str(tech_input.value),
                'consent': True,
            }
            participant_id = str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]
            session_id = str(uuid.uuid4())[:12]

            success = await run.io_bound(
                create_participant,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                demographic_data=data,
            )
            if not success:
                ui.notify(
                    'خطا در ثبت اطلاعات. لطفاً دوباره تلاش کنید.',
                    type='negative', position='top', timeout=5000,
                )
                return

            app.storage.user['participant_id'] = participant_id
            app.storage.user['session_id'] = session_id
            app.storage.user['demographic'] = data

            await run.io_bound(
                log_event_threadsafe,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                event_type='demographic_completed',
                scenario_id='demographic',
                metadata=data,
            )

            ui.notify(
                f'اطلاعات ثبت شد. کد شما: {participant_id}',
                type='positive', position='top', timeout=3000,
            )
            ui.navigate.to('/phase1')

        ui.button('شروع مأموریت', on_click=submit_form).classes(
            'w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 text-white '
            'text-xl font-bold py-4 mt-2 rounded-lg'
        )

"""
پنل توسعه‌دهنده — فقط در TEST_MODE فعال است
=============================================
امکان پرش سریع به هر بخش، بدون نیاز به تکمیل فرم‌ها.
"""
import uuid
from nicegui import ui, app
from web_app.config import (
    PAGE_CSS, TEST_MODE, TEST_PARTICIPANT_PREFIX,
)
from web_app.db_manager import get_participant, create_participant


def _get_or_create_test_participant() -> tuple[str, str] | None:
    """ایجاد یا استفاده‌ی مجدد از شرکت‌کننده‌ی تست"""
    pid = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')

    if pid and pid.startswith(TEST_PARTICIPANT_PREFIX) and session_id:
        if get_participant(pid):
            return pid, session_id

    new_pid = f"{TEST_PARTICIPANT_PREFIX}{str(uuid.uuid4())[:8]}"
    new_session = str(uuid.uuid4())[:12]
    success = create_participant(
        participant_id=new_pid,
        session_id=new_session,
        demographic_data={
            'age': 25,
            'gender': 'زن',
            'education': 'کارشناسی',
            'field_of_study': 'مهندسی',
            'work_experience': 'بدون سابقه کار',
            'gaming_experience': 'متوسط',
            'technical_familiarity': 'متوسط',
            'consent': True,
        },
    )
    if not success:
        return None

    app.storage.user['participant_id'] = new_pid
    app.storage.user['session_id'] = new_session
    return new_pid, new_session

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/feedback.py

"""صفحه‌ی بازخورد پس از بازی"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run
from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS
from web_app.db_manager import save_feedback_data, log_event_threadsafe
from web_app.data.items.postgame_feedback_items import (
    FEEDBACK_ITEMS, FEEDBACK_OPEN_QUESTIONS,
    FEEDBACK_DEMOGRAPHIC_ITEMS, compute_feedback_scores,
)


@ui.page('/feedback')
def feedback_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)
    close_answers = {}
    open_answers = {}
    demo_answers = {}

    with ui.column().classes('w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'):
        with ui.row().classes('w-full justify-between items-center'):
            ui.label('بازخورد پس از بازی').classes('text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400')
            ui.label(f'کد شما: {participant_id}').classes(
                'text-sm text-gray-400 font-mono bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1 rounded'
            )

        ui.label(
            'این بخش، بازخورد شما را درباره‌ی تجربه‌ی بازی جمع‌آوری '
            'می‌کند. پاسخ‌های شما به بهبود نسخه‌های بعدی کمک می‌کند.'
        ).classes(
            'text-base text-gray-300 text-center leading-relaxed '
            'p-4 bg-slate-800 rounded w-full mt-2 mb-4'
        )

        progress_label = ui.label(f'0 از {len(FEEDBACK_ITEMS)}').classes(
            'text-center text-orange-400 font-bold w-full mb-4'
        )

        def update_progress():
            progress_label.set_text(f'{len(close_answers)} از {len(FEEDBACK_ITEMS)}')

        def _on_feedback_radio(item_id, value):
            if value is not None:
                close_answers[item_id] = value
                update_progress()

        def _on_feedback_text(q_id, value):
            if value and value.strip():
                open_answers[q_id] = value.strip()
            else:
                open_answers.pop(q_id, None)

        def _on_demo_change(item_id, value):
            if value is not None:
                demo_answers[item_id] = value

        # ---- گویه‌های بسته ----
        for item in FEEDBACK_ITEMS:
            with ui.card().classes('w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 p-4'):
                ui.label(f"{item['id']}. {item['text']}").classes(
                    'text-base text-white w-full text-right leading-relaxed mb-3'
                )
                rb = ui.radio([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], value=None).classes('w-full justify-center')
                rb.on_value_change(
                    lambda e, iid=item['id'], r=rb: _on_feedback_radio(iid, r.value)
                )

        # ---- سؤالات باز ----
        ui.separator().classes('my-4')
        ui.label('سؤالات باز').classes('text-xl font-bold text-cyan-400 w-full text-right')
        for q in FEEDBACK_OPEN_QUESTIONS:
            with ui.card().classes('w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 p-4 mt-2'):
                ui.label(q['text']).classes(
                    'text-base text-white w-full text-right leading-relaxed mb-3'
                )
                ta = ui.textarea(placeholder='پاسخ خود را اینجا بنویسید...').classes(
                    'w-full bg-slate-700 text-white text-base p-3 rounded'
                )
                ta.on_value_change(
                    lambda e, qid=q['id'], t=ta: _on_feedback_text(qid, t.value)
                )

        # ---- دموگرافیک تکمیلی ----
        ui.separator().classes('my-4')
        ui.label('اطلاعات تکمیلی').classes('text-xl font-bold text-cyan-400 w-full text-right')
        for item in FEEDBACK_DEMOGRAPHIC_ITEMS:
            with ui.card().classes('w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 p-4 mt-2'):
                ui.label(item['text']).classes(
                    'text-base text-white w-full text-right leading-relaxed mb-3'
                )
                rb = ui.radio(item['options'], value=None).classes('w-full justify-center')
                rb.on_value_change(
                    lambda e, iid=item['id'], r=rb: _on_demo_change(iid, r.value)
                )

        async def submit_feedback():
            if len(close_answers) < len(FEEDBACK_ITEMS):
                ui.notify(
                    f'شما به {len(close_answers)} گویه از '
                    f'{len(FEEDBACK_ITEMS)} پاسخ داده‌اید.',
                    type='warning', position='top', timeout=4000,
                )
                return
            scores = compute_feedback_scores(close_answers)
            success = await run.io_bound(
                save_feedback_data,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                close_answers=close_answers,
                open_answers=open_answers,
                demographic_extra=demo_answers,
                scores=scores,
            )
            if not success:
                ui.notify('خطا در ذخیره‌ی داده.', type='negative', position='top', timeout=5000)
                return
            await run.io_bound(
                log_event_threadsafe,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                event_type='feedback_completed',
                scenario_id='feedback',
                metadata={'overall': scores['overall_score']},
            )
            ui.notify('✓ پاسخ‌های شما ثبت شد.', type='positive', position='top', timeout=3000)
            ui.navigate.to('/interlude/epilogue')

        ui.button('ثبت پاسخ‌ها و پایان', on_click=submit_feedback).classes(
            'w-full bg-green-600 hover:bg-green-500 text-white '
            'text-xl font-bold py-4 mt-4 rounded-lg'
        )

        # ✅ دکمه‌ی پرش — فقط در TEST_MODE
        from web_app.config import TEST_MODE
        if TEST_MODE:
            async def _skip_feedback():
                for item in FEEDBACK_ITEMS:
                    close_answers[item['id']] = 3
                await submit_feedback()

            ui.button(
                '⏭ پرش سریع (حالت تست)', on_click=_skip_feedback,
            ).classes(
                'w-full bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-500 text-white '
                'text-base font-bold py-3 mt-2 rounded-lg'
            )

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/hexaco.py

"""صفحه‌ی HEXACO-24"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run
from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS
from web_app.survey_helpers import render_likert_survey
from web_app.db_manager import save_hexaco_data, log_event_threadsafe
from web_app.data.items.hexaco_items import (
    HEXACO_ITEMS, LIKERT_LABELS, compute_factor_scores,
)


@ui.page('/hexaco')
def hexaco_page():
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    with ui.column().classes('w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'):
        with ui.row().classes('w-full justify-between items-center'):
            ui.label('HEXACO-24').classes('text-2xl font-bold text-cyan-400')
            ui.label(f'کد شما: {participant_id}').classes(
                'text-sm text-gray-400 font-mono bg-slate-800 px-3 py-1 rounded'
            )

        async def on_hexaco_submit(answers):
            scores = compute_factor_scores(answers)
            success = await run.io_bound(
                save_hexaco_data,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                answers=answers,
                scores=scores,
            )
            if not success:
                ui.notify(
                    'خطا در ذخیره‌ی داده. لطفاً دوباره تلاش کنید.',
                    type='negative', position='top', timeout=5000,
                )
                return
            await run.io_bound(
                log_event_threadsafe,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                session_id=session_id,
                event_type='hexaco_completed',
                scenario_id='hexaco',
                metadata={'scores': scores},
            )
            ui.notify(

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/interlude.py

"""صفحه‌ی میان‌پرده — شامل epilogue"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run

from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS, get_interlude_next
from web_app.db_manager import (
    get_relationships_web,
    get_choice_memory,
    log_event_threadsafe,
)
from web_app.data.interludes import get_interlude
from web_app.data.epilogue import compute_epilogue
from web_app.components.dialogue_viewer import (
    render_dialogue_viewer,
)


@ui.page('/interlude/{day_key}')
async def interlude_page(day_key: str):
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    # ---- بارگذاری روابط ----
    relationships = await run.io_bound(
        get_relationships_web, participant_id
    ) or {"li": 0, "rahimi": 0, "artemis": 0}

    # ---- محتوای میان‌پرده ----
    if day_key == "epilogue":
        choice_memory = await run.io_bound(
            get_choice_memory, participant_id
        ) or {}
        content = compute_epilogue(
            relationships, choice_memory
        )
    else:
        content = get_interlude(day_key, relationships)

    if not content:
        next_url = get_interlude_next(day_key)
        ui.navigate.to('/' + next_url)
        return

    # ---- ثبت رویداد ----
    await run.io_bound(
        log_event_threadsafe,
        participant_id=participant_id,
        session_id=session_id,
        event_type='interlude_started',
        scenario_id=f'interlude_{day_key}',
        metadata={'relationships': relationships},
    )

    # ---- HUD ----
    from web_app.components.hud import render_hud

    stage_key_map = {
        "day2": "interlude2",
        "day3": "interlude3",
        "day4": "interlude4",
        "epilogue": "epilogue",
    }
    await render_hud(
        stage_key=stage_key_map.get(day_key, ""),
        sub_progress=0.0,
    )

    container = ui.column().classes(
        'w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'
    )

    async def go_to_next():
        next_url = get_interlude_next(day_key)
        ui.navigate.to('/' + next_url)

    with container:
        await render_dialogue_viewer(
            dialogues=content.get("dialogues", []),
            on_complete=go_to_next,
            image_path=content.get("image"),
            title=content.get("title", ""),
            subtitle=content.get("subtitle", ""),
            body_text=content.get("body_text", ""),
        )

// File: truthline_pyqt/web_app/pages/night.py

"""صفحه‌ی شب ایستگاه"""
from nicegui import ui, app, run

from web_app.config import (
    PAGE_CSS, NIGHT_NEXT, load_night_data,
)
from web_app.db_manager import (
    update_relationship_web, log_event_threadsafe,
    get_relationships_web,
)
from web_app.components.dialogue_viewer import (
    render_dialogue_viewer,
)


@ui.page('/night/{night_num}')
async def night_page(night_num: str):
    participant_id = app.storage.user.get('participant_id')
    session_id = app.storage.user.get('session_id')
    if not participant_id or not session_id:
        ui.navigate.to('/')
        return

    ui.query('body').style(PAGE_CSS)

    # ---- HUD ----
    from web_app.components.hud import render_hud
    await render_hud(
        stage_key=f"night{night_num}",
        sub_progress=0.0,
    )

    night_data = load_night_data(night_num)
    if not night_data:
        # داده‌ی این شب نبود — مستقیم برو به بعدی
        next_url = NIGHT_NEXT.get(night_num, 'hexaco')
        ui.navigate.to('/' + next_url)
        return

    container = ui.column().classes(
        'w-full max-w-4xl mx-auto p-8 gap-4'
    )

    async def go_to_next():
        next_url = NIGHT_NEXT.get(night_num, 'hexaco')
        ui.navigate.to('/' + next_url)

    async def render_choices():
        container.clear()
        with container:
            # ---- هدر ----
            ui.label(night_data.get("title", "")).classes(
                'text-3xl font-bold text-cyan-400 '
                'text-center w-full'
            )
            ui.label(night_data.get("subtitle", "")).classes(
                'text-xl text-orange-400 text-center w-full'
            )

            # ---- مقدمه ----
            if night_data.get("intro"):
                with ui.card().classes(
                    'w-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 '
                    'p-4 mt-2'
                ):
                    ui.label(
                        night_data["intro"]
                    ).classes(
                        'text-base text-gray-300 leading-relaxed '
                        'w-full text-right whitespace-pre-line'
                    )

            # ---- دستور ----
            ui.label(
                "این شب را چطور می‌گذرانی؟"
            ).classes(
                'text-lg font-bold text-white w-full text-right mt-4'
            )

            # ---- فعالیت‌ها ----
            activities = night_data.get("activities", {})
            order = ["li", "artemis", "stars"]

            for key in order:
                activity = activities.get(key)
                if not activity:
                    continue

                async def _pick(k=key):
                    await on_activity_chosen(k)

                with ui.card().classes(
                    'w-full bg-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-600 '
                    'border-2 border-slate-500 cursor-pointer p-4 mt-2'
                ).on('click', _pick):
                    with ui.column().classes('gap-1 w-full'):
                        ui.label(
                            activity.get("label", key)
                        ).classes(
                            'text-base text-white font-bold '
                            'w-full text-right'
                        )
                        if activity.get("hint"):
                            ui.label(
                                activity["hint"]
                            ).classes(
                                'text-sm text-gray-400 italic '
                                'w-full text-right'
                            )

    async def on_activity_chosen(activity_key: str):
        activity = night_data.get("activities", {}).get(
            activity_key
        )
        if not activity:
            return

        # ---- اعمال اثر بر روابط ----
        effect = activity.get("effect", {}) or {}
        for char, delta in effect.items():
            await run.io_bound(
                update_relationship_web,
                participant_id=participant_id,
                character_key=char,
                delta=int(delta),
            )

        # ---- ثبت رویداد ----
        await run.io_bound(
            log_event_threadsafe,
            participant_id=participant_id,
            session_id=session_id,
            event_type='night_activity_chosen',
            scenario_id=f'night_{night_num}',
            metadata={
                'activity': activity_key,
                'effect': effect,
            },
        )

        # ---- نمایش دیالوگ‌های فعالیت ----
        container.clear()
        with container:
            await render_dialogue_viewer(
                dialogues=activity.get("dialogues", []),
                on_complete=go_to_next,
                title=night_data.get("title", ""),
                subtitle=night_data.get("subtitle", ""),
            )

    await render_choices()

from typing import Any, Callable, TypeVar, cast

from nicegui import ui, app, run

from web_app.config import PAGE_CSS
from web_app.db_manager import (
    get_connection,
    get_relationships_web,
)


COMPETENCY_FA = {
    "honesty": "صداقت و یکپارچگی",

    "problem_solving": "حل مسئله",
    "accountability": "مسئولیت‌پذیری",
}
COMPETENCY_ORDER = list(COMPETENCY_FA.keys())


INTERPRETATIONS = {
    ("honesty", "high"):

        "می‌یابد.",
    ("trustworthiness", "high"):
        "به شکلی قابل اتکا به تعهدات و وعده‌های خود "

    ("trustworthiness", "mid"):
        "قابلیت اعتماد شما در شرایط عادی خوب است، اما "

        "در حفظ تعهدات و شفافیت نیاز به تمرین و "

        "تحلیل‌گر نظام‌مندی هستید که مسائل پیچیده را "

    ("problem_solving", "mid"):
        "در حل مسائل توانمندید، اما در شرایط ابهام "
