                "max-height: 1px; border: none;"
            )
            sep.setAttribute(
                Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents,
                True,
            )
            text_col.addWidget(sep)

        text = choice.get("text_fa", choice.get("text", ""))
        self.label = QLabel(f"{RLM}{text}")
        self.label.setWordWrap(True)
        self.label.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 13))
        self.label.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FFFFFF; background: transparent; "
            "border: none;"
        )
        self.label.setLayoutDirection(
            Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft
        )
        self.label.setAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight
            | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignAbsolute
            | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter
        )
        self.label.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        text_col.addWidget(self.label)

        layout.addLayout(text_col, 1)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_bg_intensity(self, value: float):
        """تنظیم شدت پس‌زمینه (برای انیمیشن ورود)"""
        self._bg_intensity = max(0.0, min(1.0, value))
        self._apply_style()

    def _apply_style(self):
        """اعمال استایل با شدت فعلی"""
        # رنگ پس‌زمینه بین #0B1D3A و #1A2A4A نوسان می‌کند
        intensity = self._bg_intensity
        # از شفافیت استفاده می‌کنیم (rgba)
        alpha = int(40 + 120 * intensity)  # 40 تا 160
        self.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QFrame#choiceButton {{
                background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, {alpha / 255:.3f});
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 12px;
            }}
        """)

    def _apply_hover_style(self):
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame#choiceButton {
                background-color: #2B4A6F;
                border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
                border-radius: 12px;
            }
        """)

    def enterEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._apply_hover_style()
        super().enterEvent(event)

    def leaveEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._apply_style()  # بازگشت به حالت عادی (با intensity فعلی)
        super().leaveEvent(event)

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self.clicked.emit(self.choice_data)
        super().mousePressEvent(event)


# ====================================================================
# ویجت اصلی
# ====================================================================
class ChoiceWidget(QWidget):
    choice_made = pyqtSignal(dict, int)

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.choices = []
        self.buttons = []
        self.decision_start_time = 0
        self.is_visible = False
        self._already_emitted = False
        self._scenario_id: str = ""
        # ✅ نگه‌داری تایمرهای انیمیشن
        self._anim_timers: list = []

        self._setup_ui()
        print("✓ ChoiceWidget راه‌اندازی شد (نسخه 2.2)")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _setup_ui(self):
        main_layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        main_layout.setContentsMargins(30, 20, 30, 20)
        main_layout.setSpacing(12)

        title_label = QLabel("انتخاب کنید:")
        title_font = QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 22)
        title_font.setBold(True)
        title_label.setFont(title_font)
        title_label.setStyleSheet("QLabel { color: #4FC3F7; }")
        title_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        main_layout.addWidget(title_label)

        scroll = QScrollArea()
        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        scroll.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame)
        scroll.setStyleSheet(
            "QScrollArea { background-color: transparent; "
            "border: none; }"
        )
        scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(
            Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff
        )

        scroll_content = QWidget()
        scroll_content.setStyleSheet(
            "background-color: transparent;"
        )
        self.buttons_container = QVBoxLayout(scroll_content)
        self.buttons_container.setSpacing(14)
        self.buttons_container.setContentsMargins(6, 6, 6, 6)
        self.buttons_container.addStretch()

        scroll.setWidget(scroll_content)
        main_layout.addWidget(scroll, stretch=1)

        self.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def show_choices(self, choices: list, scenario_id: str = ""):
        self._stop_all_anims()
        self._clear_buttons()
        self._already_emitted = False
        self._scenario_id = scenario_id

        shuffled = list(choices)
        random.shuffle(shuffled)

        self.choices = shuffled
        self.is_visible = True
        self.decision_start_time = time.time()

        for i, choice in enumerate(shuffled):
            display_number = i + 1
            btn = ChoiceButton(choice, display_number)
            btn.clicked.connect(self._on_choice_clicked)
            self.buttons_container.insertWidget(
                self.buttons_container.count() - 1, btn
            )
            self.buttons.append(btn)

            # ✅ شروع از شدت 0
            btn.set_bg_intensity(0.0)

            delay = i * STAGGER_DELAY_MS
            QTimer.singleShot(
                delay,
                lambda b=btn: self._animate_button_in(b),
            )

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _animate_button_in(self, btn: ChoiceButton):
        """انیمیشن ورود با تغییر تدریجی رنگ پس‌زمینه"""
        try:
            _ = btn.width()
        except RuntimeError:
            return

        step = {"i": 0}

        timer = QTimer(self)

        def _tick():
            step["i"] += 1
            progress = min(1.0, step["i"] / ANIM_STEPS)
            try:
                btn.set_bg_intensity(progress)
            except RuntimeError:
                timer.stop()
                return
            if progress >= 1.0:
                timer.stop()

        timer.timeout.connect(_tick)
        interval = max(20, FADE_IN_MS // ANIM_STEPS)
        timer.start(interval)
        self._anim_timers.append(timer)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_choice_clicked(self, choice: dict):
        if self._already_emitted:
            print("⚠️ تلاش برای emit دوباره نادیده گرفته شد")
            return
        self._already_emitted = True

        decision_time = int(
            (time.time() - self.decision_start_time) * 1000
        )

        self.choice_made.emit(choice, decision_time)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _stop_all_anims(self):
        for timer in self._anim_timers:
            try:
                timer.stop()
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
        self._anim_timers.clear()

    def _clear_buttons(self):
        for button in self.buttons:
            try:
                self.buttons_container.removeWidget(button)
                button.deleteLater()
            except RuntimeError:
                pass
        self.buttons.clear()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def hide_choices(self):
        self._stop_all_anims()
        self._clear_buttons()
        self.is_visible = False
        self.hide()

    def is_showing(self) -> bool:
        return self.is_visible

// File: truthline_pyqt/widgets/context_menu.py

"""
منوی راست‌کلیک سراسری
========================
- روی هرجای بازی با راست‌کلیک ظاهر می‌شود
- شامل: ذخیره‌ی دستی، راهنمای کلیدها، بازگشت به منو، خروج
- در صحنه‌های فاز و منو کار می‌کند

نسخه: 1.0.0
"""
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QMenu, QMessageBox, QWidget
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt
from PyQt6.QtGui import QAction, QFont

FONT_FAMILY = "Vazirmatn"


class GameContextMenu(QMenu):
    """منوی راست‌کلیک بازی"""

    def __init__(self, main_window, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.main_window = main_window

        self.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11))
        self.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)
        self.setStyleSheet("""
            QMenu {
                background-color: #1A2A4A;
                color: #FFFFFF;
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 6px;
                padding: 6px;
                font-family: 'Vazirmatn';
                font-size: 11px;
            }
            QMenu::item {
                padding: 8px 20px;
                border-radius: 4px;
            }
            QMenu::item:selected {
                background-color: #4FC3F7;
                color: #0B1D3A;
            }
            QMenu::separator {
                height: 1px;
                background-color: #2B4A6F;
                margin: 4px 8px;
            }
        """)

        self._build_menu()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_menu(self):
        # ذخیره‌ی دستی
        save_action = QAction("💾  ذخیره‌ی دستی", self)
        save_action.triggered.connect(self._on_save)
        self.addAction(save_action)

        # بازگشت به منو
        menu_action = QAction("🏠  بازگشت به منو", self)
        menu_action.triggered.connect(self._on_back_to_menu)
        self.addAction(menu_action)

        self.addSeparator()

        # راهنمای کلیدها
        shortcuts_action = QAction("⌨️  راهنمای کلیدها", self)
        shortcuts_action.triggered.connect(
            self._on_show_shortcuts
        )
        self.addAction(shortcuts_action)

        # دفترچه
        log_action = QAction("📔  دفترچه‌ی مأموریت", self)
        log_action.triggered.connect(self._on_show_log)
        self.addAction(log_action)

        # پرونده
        dossier_action = QAction("👥  پرونده‌ی شخصیت‌ها", self)
        dossier_action.triggered.connect(self._on_show_dossier)
        self.addAction(dossier_action)

        self.addSeparator()

        # بستن منو
        close_action = QAction("✕  بستن منو", self)
        close_action.triggered.connect(self.close)
        self.addAction(close_action)

    # ================================================================
    def _on_save(self):
        try:
            from core.backup_manager import create_backup
            path = create_backup(reason="manual")
            if path:
                QMessageBox.information(
                    self.main_window,
                    "ذخیره شد",
                    f"✓ پشتیبان ساخته شد:\n{path}",
                )
            else:
                QMessageBox.warning(
                    self.main_window,
                    "خطا",
                    "ذخیره‌سازی ناموفق بود.",
                )
        except Exception as e:
            QMessageBox.warning(
                self.main_window,
                "خطا",
                f"ذخیره‌سازی ناموفق:\n{e}",
            )

    def _on_back_to_menu(self):
        reply = QMessageBox.question(
            self.main_window,
            "بازگشت به منو",
            "آیا می‌خواهید به منوی اصلی بازگردید؟\n"
            "پیشرفت جلسه ذخیره می‌شود.",
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes
            | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
        )
        if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return

        try:
            gm = self.main_window.game_manager
            # ذخیره‌ی وضعیت
            try:
                gm.save_session()
            except Exception:
                pass
            gm.change_scene("menu")
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ خطا در بازگشت به منو: {e}")

    def _on_show_shortcuts(self):
        try:
            from widgets.shortcuts_panel import ShortcutsDialog
            dlg = ShortcutsDialog(self.main_window)
            dlg.exec()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ خطا در نمایش میانبرها: {e}")

    def _on_show_log(self):
        try:
            if hasattr(self.main_window, "_open_mission_log"):
                self.main_window._open_mission_log()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ خطا در نمایش دفترچه: {e}")

    def _on_show_dossier(self):
        try:
            if hasattr(
                self.main_window, "_open_character_dossier"
            ):
                self.main_window._open_character_dossier()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ خطا در نمایش پرونده: {e}")


def install_context_menu(widget: QWidget, main_window):
    """نصب منوی راست‌کلیک روی یک widget"""
    widget.setContextMenuPolicy(
        Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu
    )

    def _show_menu(pos):
        menu = GameContextMenu(main_window, widget)
        menu.exec(widget.mapToGlobal(pos))

    widget.customContextMenuRequested.connect(_show_menu)

// File: truthline_pyqt/widgets/decision_trail_widget.py

"""
نقشه‌ی تصمیم — خط افقی با نقاط توپر/خالی
============================================
طراحی بی‌طرف: هیچ رنگ یا کیفیتی نشان نمی‌دهد.
- نقطه‌ی توپر: تصمیم گرفته‌شده
- نقطه‌ی خالی: در انتظار

نسخه: 1.0.0
"""
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QPointF
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPainter, QPen, QBrush, QColor


class DecisionTrailWidget(QWidget):
    """نقشه‌ی تصمیم — خط افقی با نقاط"""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._total: int = 0
        self._filled: int = 0
        self.setMinimumHeight(26)
        self.setMinimumWidth(180)
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent;")

    def set_total(self, total: int):
        self._total = max(0, int(total))
        self._filled = 0
        self.update()

    def mark_next(self):
        if self._filled < self._total:
            self._filled += 1
            self.update()

    def reset(self):
        self._filled = 0
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if self._total <= 0:
            return

        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)

        w = self.width()
        h = self.height()
        cy = h / 2

        # نقطه‌های شروع و پایان
        margin = 12
        start_x = margin
        end_x = w - margin

        if self._total == 1:
            positions = [(start_x + end_x) / 2]
        else:
            step = (end_x - start_x) / (self._total - 1)
            positions = [start_x + i * step
                         for i in range(self._total)]

        # خط افقی
        line_color = QColor(79, 195, 247, 80)
        painter.setPen(QPen(line_color, 2))
        painter.drawLine(
            int(start_x), int(cy), int(end_x), int(cy)
        )

        # نقاط
        for i, x in enumerate(positions):
            if i < self._filled:
                # توپر
                painter.setPen(QPen(QColor("#4FC3F7"), 2))
                painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor("#4FC3F7")))
                painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(x, cy), 6, 6)
            else:
                # خالی
                painter.setPen(QPen(QColor(79, 195, 247, 130), 2))
                painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
                painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(x, cy), 6, 6)

        painter.end()

            "color: #B0BEC5; border: none;"
        )
        brief.setWordWrap(True)
        brief.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        text_col.addWidget(brief)

        layout.addLayout(text_col, 1)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def mousePressEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if self._is_disabled:
            return
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self._drag_start = event.pos()
            self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.ClosedHandCursor)
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

    def mouseReleaseEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.OpenHandCursor)
        self._drag_start = None
        super().mouseReleaseEvent(event)

    def mouseMoveEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if self._is_disabled or self._drag_start is None:
            return
        if not (event.buttons() & Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton):
            return
        dist = (event.pos() - self._drag_start).manhattanLength()
        if dist < 8:
            return

        drag = QDrag(self)
        mime = QMimeData()
        mime.setData(MIME_TYPE, self.action_id.encode("utf-8"))
        mime.setText(self.action_id)
        drag.setMimeData(mime)

        # نمای درگ
        pixmap = self.grab()
        # شفافیت ۸۰٪
        faded = QPixmap(pixmap.size())
        faded.fill(Qt.GlobalColor.transparent)
        painter = QPainter(faded)
        painter.setOpacity(0.8)
        painter.drawPixmap(0, 0, pixmap)
        painter.end()
        drag.setPixmap(faded)
        drag.setHotSpot(event.pos())

        drag.exec(Qt.DropAction.MoveAction)
        self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.OpenHandCursor)

class _DropSlot(QFrame):
    """جایگاه که می‌تواند یک کارت را در خود جا دهد"""

    dropped = pyqtSignal(int, str)  # slot_index, action_id
    cleared = pyqtSignal(int)

    def __init__(self, index: int, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.slot_index = index
        self._filled_action_id: str | None = None
        self._is_highlighted = False

        self.setAcceptDrops(True)
        self.setMinimumHeight(52)
        self.setMaximumHeight(64)
        self._apply_style()

        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 4, 10, 4)
        layout.setSpacing(8)

        self.num_lbl = QLabel(f"{index + 1}.")
        self.num_lbl.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        self.num_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FF8F00; border: none;"
        )
        self.num_lbl.setFixedWidth(28)
        layout.addWidget(self.num_lbl)

        self.icon_lbl = QLabel("—")
        self.icon_lbl.setFont(QFont("Arial", 16))
        self.icon_lbl.setStyleSheet("border: none;")
        self.icon_lbl.setFixedWidth(28)
        layout.addWidget(self.icon_lbl)

        self.name_lbl = QLabel("خالی")
        self.name_lbl.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11))
        self.name_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #666666; border: none;"
        )
        self.name_lbl.setLayoutDirection(
            Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft
        )
        self.name_lbl.setAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight
            | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignAbsolute
        )
        layout.addWidget(self.name_lbl, 1)

        # دکمه‌ی حذف کارت
        self.clear_btn = QPushButton("✕")
        self.clear_btn.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12))
        self.clear_btn.setFixedSize(26, 26)
        self.clear_btn.setCursor(
            Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor
        )
        self.clear_btn.setFocusPolicy(
            Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus
        )
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(False)
        self.clear_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: transparent;
                color: #D32F2F;
                border: 1px solid #D32F2F;
                border-radius: 13px;
                padding: 0;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #D32F2F;
                color: #FFFFFF;
            }
        """)
        self.clear_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_clear_clicked)
        layout.addWidget(self.clear_btn)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _apply_style(self):
        if self._is_highlighted:
            self.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame {
                    background-color: rgba(79, 195, 247, 0.20);
                    border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
                    border-radius: 6px;
                }
            """)
        elif self._filled_action_id is not None:
            self.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame {
                    background-color: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.10);
                    border: 2px solid #4CAF50;
                    border-radius: 6px;
                }
            """)
        else:
            self.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame {
                    background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.5);
                    border: 2px dashed #4FC3F7;
                    border-radius: 6px;
                }
            """)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def get_action_id(self) -> str | None:
        return self._filled_action_id

    def set_action(self, action_id: str, name: str, icon: str):
        self._filled_action_id = action_id
        self.icon_lbl.setText(icon)
        self.name_lbl.setText(name)
        self.name_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FFFFFF; border: none;"
        )
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(True)
        self._apply_style()

    def clear_action(self):
        self._filled_action_id = None
        self.icon_lbl.setText("—")
        self.name_lbl.setText("خالی")
        self.name_lbl.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #666666; border: none;"
        )
        self.clear_btn.setVisible(False)
        self._apply_style()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def dragEnterEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if event.mimeData().hasFormat(MIME_TYPE):
            self._is_highlighted = True
            self._apply_style()
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            event.ignore()

    def dragLeaveEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._is_highlighted = False
        self._apply_style()

    def dropEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        self._is_highlighted = False
        self._apply_style()
        if event.mimeData().hasFormat(MIME_TYPE):
            action_id = bytes(
                event.mimeData().data(MIME_TYPE)
            ).decode("utf-8")
            self.dropped.emit(self.slot_index, action_id)
            event.acceptProposedAction()
        else:
            event.ignore()

    def _on_clear_clicked(self):
        if self._filled_action_id is not None:
            self.cleared.emit(self.slot_index)

class DependencyBoardWidget(QWidget):
    """تخته چیدمان اقدامات — با Drag&Drop"""

    board_done = pyqtSignal(dict)

    def __init__(self, actions: list, correct_order: list,
                 parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.action_list = actions
        self.correct_order = correct_order

        self.start_time = int(time.time() * 1000)
        self.first_action_time = 0
        self.sequence: list = []
        self.is_done = False

        self.action_map = {a["id"]: a for a in actions}
        self.action_cards: dict = {}
        self.slots: list = []

        self._setup_ui()
        self.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)

    # ================================================================
    def _setup_ui(self):

        # توضیح

        # دو ستون

        main_layout.addLayout(columns, stretch=1)

        # دکمه‌ی ثبت
        self.submit_btn = QPushButton("ثبت ترتیب و اجرا")
        self.submit_btn.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 13, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        self.submit_btn.setMinimumHeight(44)
        self.submit_btn.setCursor(
            Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor
        )
        self.submit_btn.setFocusPolicy(Qt.FocusPolicy.NoFocus)
        self.submit_btn.setEnabled(False)
        self.submit_btn.setStyleSheet("""
            QPushButton {
                background-color: #2B4A6F;
                color: #FFFFFF;
                border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                border-radius: 8px;
                padding: 8px;
            }
            QPushButton:hover {
                background-color: #4FC3F7;
                color: #0B1D3A;
            }
            QPushButton:disabled {
                background-color: #1A2A4A;
                color: #666666;
                border: 2px solid #444444;
            }
        """)
        self.submit_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_submit)
        main_layout.addWidget(self.submit_btn)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_available_column(self):
        container = QFrame()
        container.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.3);
                border: 1px solid #2B4A6F;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
        """)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(container)
        layout.setContentsMargins(8, 8, 8, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(6)

        header = QLabel("اقدامات در دسترس")
        header.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        header.setStyleSheet("color: #4FC3F7; border: none;")
        header.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        layout.addWidget(header)

        scroll = QScrollArea()
        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        scroll.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame)
        scroll.setStyleSheet(
            "QScrollArea { background-color: transparent; "
            "border: none; }"
        )

        content = QWidget()
        content.setStyleSheet("background-color: transparent;")
        content_layout = QVBoxLayout(content)
        content_layout.setContentsMargins(2, 2, 2, 2)
        content_layout.setSpacing(6)

        # shuffle
        import random
        shuffled = list(self.action_list)
        random.shuffle(shuffled)
        print(
            f"   [SPA-01] ترتیب shuffle شده: "
            f"{[a['id'] for a in shuffled]}"
        )

        for action in shuffled:
            card = _DraggableCard(action)
            content_layout.addWidget(card)
            self.action_cards[action["id"]] = card

        content_layout.addStretch()
        scroll.setWidget(content)
        layout.addWidget(scroll)

        return container

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_slots_column(self):
        container = QFrame()
        container.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(255, 143, 0, 0.05);
                border: 2px dashed #FF8F00;
                border-radius: 8px;
            }
        """)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(container)
        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 8, 10, 8)
        layout.setSpacing(4)

        header = QLabel("ترتیب اقدامات")
        header.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 12, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        header.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FF8F00; border: none;"
        )
        header.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        layout.addWidget(header)

        for i in range(len(self.correct_order)):
            slot = _DropSlot(i)
            slot.dropped.connect(self._on_slot_dropped)
            slot.cleared.connect(self._on_slot_cleared)
            layout.addWidget(slot)
            self.slots.append(slot)

        layout.addStretch()
        return container

    # ================================================================
    def _on_slot_dropped(self, slot_index: int, action_id: str):
        if self.is_done:
            return
        if action_id in self.sequence:
            # کارت قبلاً استفاده شده
            return

        if self.first_action_time == 0:
            self.first_action_time = (
                int(time.time() * 1000) - self.start_time
            )

        # اگر جایگاه قبلاً پر است، کارت قبلی را آزاد کن
        existing = self.slots[slot_index].get_action_id()
        if existing is not None:
            if existing in self.sequence:
                self.sequence.remove(existing)
            # برگرداندن کارت به حالت فعال
            self._set_card_active(existing, True)

        # پر کردن جایگاه
        action = self.action_map.get(action_id, {})
        self.slots[slot_index].set_action(
            action_id,
            action.get("name", "?"),
            action.get("icon", "●"),
        )
        self._set_card_active(action_id, False)

        # به‌روزرسانی sequence
        self.sequence = []
        for slot in self.slots:
            sid = slot.get_action_id()
            if sid is not None:
                self.sequence.append(sid)

        self._update_buttons()

    def _on_slot_cleared(self, slot_index: int):
        if self.is_done:
            return
        action_id = self.slots[slot_index].get_action_id()
        if action_id is None:
            return

        self.slots[slot_index].clear_action()
        if action_id in self.sequence:
            self.sequence.remove(action_id)
        self._set_card_active(action_id, True)

        # به‌روزرسانی sequence
        self.sequence = []
        for slot in self.slots:
            sid = slot.get_action_id()
            if sid is not None:
                self.sequence.append(sid)

        self._update_buttons()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _set_card_active(self, action_id: str, active: bool):
        card = self.action_cards.get(action_id)
        if card is None:
            return
        card._is_disabled = not active
        if active:
            card.setVisible(True)
            card.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame#actionCard {
                    background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.85);
                    border: 2px solid #4FC3F7;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                }
                QFrame#actionCard:hover {
                    background-color: rgba(79, 195, 247, 0.20);
                    border: 2px solid #FFFFFF;
                }
            """)
        else:
            card.setStyleSheet("""
                QFrame#actionCard {
                    background-color: rgba(26, 42, 74, 0.3);
                    border: 2px solid #444444;
                    border-radius: 8px;
                }
            """)

    def _update_buttons(self):
        self.submit_btn.setEnabled(
            len(self.sequence) == len(self.correct_order)
        )

    # ================================================================
    def _on_submit(self):
        if self.is_done:
            return
        if len(self.sequence) != len(self.correct_order):
            return
        self.is_done = True

        total_time = int(time.time() * 1000) - self.start_time

        distractor_ids = [
            a["id"] for a in self.action_list
            if a.get("is_distractor", False)
        ]

        score = self._sequence_score(
            self.sequence, self.correct_order, distractor_ids
        )

        distractor_used = [
            item for item in self.sequence
            if item in distractor_ids
        ]

        result = {
            "sequence": list(self.sequence),
            "correct_order": list(self.correct_order),
            "sequence_score": score,
            "planning_time_ms": self.first_action_time,
            "total_time_ms": total_time,
            "distractor_ids": distractor_ids,
            "distractor_used": distractor_used,
            "distractor_count": len(distractor_used),
        }
        print(f"   [DEBUG] نتیجه SPA-01: {result}")
        self.board_done.emit(result)

    def _sequence_score(self, seq: list, correct: list,
                         distractor_ids: list | None = None) -> float:
        if distractor_ids is None:
            distractor_ids = []

        m, n = len(seq), len(correct)
        dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
        for i in range(1, m + 1):
            for j in range(1, n + 1):
                if seq[i - 1] == correct[j - 1]:
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1
                else:
                    dp[i][j] = max(
                        dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]
                    )

        base_score = dp[m][n] / max(1, n)
        distractor_count = sum(
            1 for item in seq if item in distractor_ids
        )
        penalty = distractor_count * 0.15

        final = max(0.0, base_score - penalty)
        return round(final, 3)

    # ================================================================
    def _start_pulse(self):
        """شروع تایمر pulse — بعد از آماده شدن ویجت"""
        if not self._pulse_timer.isActive():
            self._pulse_timer.start(80)

    def _tick_pulse(self):
        """تیک انیمیشن pulse"""
        self._pulse_phase += 0.1
        if self._pulse_phase > 2 * math.pi:
            self._pulse_phase -= 2 * math.pi
        # ✅ فقط اگر visible و اندازه معقول دارد، update کن
        if not self.isVisible():
            return
        if self.width() < 10 or self.height() < 10:
            return
        self.update()

    def showEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        super().showEvent(event)
        if not self._pulse_timer.isActive():
            self._pulse_timer.start(80)

    def hideEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        super().hideEvent(event)
        if self._pulse_timer.isActive():
            self._pulse_timer.stop()

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        try:
            self._pulse_timer.stop()
        except Exception:
            pass
        super().closeEvent(event)

        df_layout = QVBoxLayout(self.detail_frame)
        df_layout.setContentsMargins(15, 10, 15, 10)
        df_layout.setSpacing(4)

        self.detail_title = QLabel("جزئیات سیستم انتخاب‌شده:")
        self.detail_title.setFont(
            QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11, QFont.Weight.Bold)
        )
        self.detail_title.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #4FC3F7; border: none;"
        )
        df_layout.addWidget(self.detail_title)

        self.detail_text = QLabel(
            "برای مشاهده جزئیات، روی «بررسی» هر کارت کلیک کنید."
        )
        self.detail_text.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 11))
        self.detail_text.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #FFFFFF; border: none;"
        )
        self.detail_text.setWordWrap(True)
        self.detail_text.setMinimumHeight(60)
        self.detail_text.setLayoutDirection(
            Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft
        )
        self.detail_text.setAlignment(
            Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight
            | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignAbsolute
        )
        df_layout.addWidget(self.detail_text)

        main_layout.addWidget(self.detail_frame)

        # گرید کارت‌ها
        grid = QGridLayout()
        grid.setHorizontalSpacing(10)
        grid.setVerticalSpacing(10)

        for i, system in enumerate(self.systems):
            row = i // 3
            col = i % 3
            card = self._create_system_card(system)
            grid.addWidget(card, row, col)
            self.cards[system["id"]] = card
            grid.setColumnStretch(col, 1)
            grid.setRowStretch(row, 1)

        main_layout.addLayout(grid, stretch=1)

    # ================================================================
    # ✅ paintEvent مستقیماً روی خود ویجت — بدون overlay
    # ================================================================
    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        # قبل از رسم، اجازه بده Qt بک‌گراند و فرزندان را رسم کند
        # (این متد ابتدا فراخوانی می‌شود و سپس فرزندان رسم می‌شوند)
        super().paintEvent(event)

        # ✅ حفاظت‌های ساده
        if self.width() < 10 or self.height() < 10:
            return
        if not self.cards:
            return

        painter = QPainter(self)
        if not painter.isActive():
            return

        try:
            painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)

            # ✅ snapshot برای جلوگیری از تغییر حین پیمایش
            for sid, card in list(self.cards.items()):
                deps = SYSTEM_DEPENDENCIES.get(sid, [])
                for dep_id in deps:
                    dep_card = self.cards.get(dep_id)
                    if dep_card is None:
                        continue

                    try:
                        if not card.isVisible():
                            continue
                        if not dep_card.isVisible():
                            continue
                    except RuntimeError:
                        continue

                    # ✅ مختصات: هر دو کارت فرزند مستقیم self هستند
                    #    پس card.pos() نسبت به self است
                    try:
                        p1 = card.pos() + card.rect().center()
                        p2 = dep_card.pos() + dep_card.rect().center()
                    except RuntimeError:
                        continue

                    color = QColor("#4FC3F7")
                    color.setAlpha(60)

                    if self.investigating in (sid, dep_id):
                        pulse = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(
                            self._pulse_phase
                        )
                        color.setAlpha(int(80 + 100 * pulse))

                    painter.setPen(
                        QPen(color, 1.5, Qt.PenStyle.DashLine)
                    )
                    painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
                    painter.drawLine(p1, p2)

                    self._draw_arrow(
                        painter,
                        QPointF(p1),
                        QPointF(p2),
                        color,
                    )
        finally:
            try:
                painter.end()
            except Exception:
                pass

    # ================================================================
    def _draw_arrow(self, painter, p1, p2, color):
        """رسم فلش کوچک نزدیک p2"""
        angle = math.atan2(p2.y() - p1.y(), p2.x() - p1.x())
        arrow_len = 10

        margin = 40
        dx = p2.x() - p1.x()
        dy = p2.y() - p1.y()
        dist = math.hypot(dx, dy)
        if dist < margin * 2:
            return

        tip_x = p2.x() - margin * dx / dist
        tip_y = p2.y() - margin * dy / dist

        left_angle = angle + math.pi * 0.8
        right_angle = angle - math.pi * 0.8

        painter.setPen(QPen(color, 1.5))
        painter.drawLine(
            QPointF(tip_x, tip_y),
            QPointF(
                tip_x + arrow_len * math.cos(left_angle),
                tip_y + arrow_len * math.sin(left_angle),
            ),
        )
        painter.drawLine(
            QPointF(tip_x, tip_y),
            QPointF(
                tip_x + arrow_len * math.cos(right_angle),
                tip_y + arrow_len * math.sin(right_angle),
            ),
        )

    def _card_style_neutral(self, system_id: str) -> str:

    def _card_style_investigating(self, system_id: str) -> str:
        return """

    # ================================================================
    def _on_inspect(self, system_id):
        if self.is_done:
            return
        if self.investigating is not None:
            return

        if system_id in self.investigated:
            self.perseveration_count += 1
            self._show_detail(system_id)
            return

        if self.time_to_first_action == 0:
            self.time_to_first_action = (
                int(time.time() * 1000) - self.start_time
            )

        self.investigating = system_id
        self._investigation_start = int(time.time() * 1000)

        card = self.cards[system_id]
        inspect_btn = self.inspect_buttons[system_id]
        inspect_btn.setEnabled(False)
        inspect_btn.setText("⏳ در حال بررسی...")

        card.setStyleSheet(
            self._card_style_investigating(system_id)
        )

        self._start_progress_animation(system_id)

        QTimer.singleShot(
            self.investigation_time_ms, self._finish_inspect
        )

    def _start_progress_animation(self, system_id):
        bar = self.progress_bars.get(system_id)
        if bar is None:
            return

        self._progress_steps = getattr(
            self, "_progress_steps", {}
        )
        self._progress_steps[system_id] = 0

        def _step():
            step = self._progress_steps.get(system_id, 0)
            if step >= 100:
                return
            step = min(100, step + 10)
            self._progress_steps[system_id] = step
            bar.setStyleSheet(f"""
                background-color: rgba(79, 195, 247, 0.15);
                border: none;
                border-radius: 2px;
            """)
            bar.setMinimumWidth(int(bar.width() * step / 100) or 1)
            QTimer.singleShot(150, _step)

        _step()

    def _finish_inspect(self):
        system_id = self.investigating
        if not system_id:
            return

        elapsed = int(time.time() * 1000) - self._investigation_start
        self.investigation_times[system_id] = elapsed
        self.investigated.append(system_id)
        self.investigating = None

        print(f"   [DEBUG] بررسی سیستم: {system_id} ({elapsed}ms)")

        card = self.cards[system_id]
        card.setStyleSheet(
            self._card_style_investigated(system_id)
        )

        inspect_btn = self.inspect_buttons[system_id]
        inspect_btn.setText("↻ مشاهده دوباره")
        inspect_btn.setEnabled(True)

        bar = self.progress_bars.get(system_id)
        if bar is not None:
            bar.setStyleSheet(
                "background-color: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.4); "
                "border: none; border-radius: 2px;"
            )
            bar.setMinimumWidth(0)

        mark_btn = self.mark_buttons[system_id]
        mark_btn.setVisible(True)

        self._show_detail(system_id)

        count = len(self.investigated)
        total = len(self.systems)
        if count >= total - 1:
            self.status_label.setText(
                f"✓ {count} از {total} سیستم بررسی شد — "
                "می‌توانی علت را علامت‌گذاری کنی."
            )
            self.status_label.setStyleSheet(
                "color: #4CAF50; padding: 4px; font-weight: bold;"
            )
        else:
            self.status_label.setText(
                f"بررسی‌شده: {count} از {total} — "
                "برای یافتن الگو، سیستم‌های بیشتری را بررسی کن."
            )

    def _show_detail(self, system_id):
        system = next(
            (s for s in self.systems if s["id"] == system_id),
            None,
        )
        if not system:
            return
        self.detail_title.setText(
            f"جزئیات: {system['icon']} {system['name']}"
        )
        self.detail_text.setText(system.get("detail", ""))

    # ================================================================
    def _on_mark(self, system_id):
        if self.is_done:
            return

        if len(self.investigated) < 2:
            reply = QMessageBox.question(
                self, "تأیید تصمیم",
                "شما فقط یک سیستم را بررسی کرده‌اید. "
                "آیا مطمئنید که علت ریشه‌ای را درست "
                "تشخیص داده‌اید؟",
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes
                | QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,
            )
            if reply != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
                return

        self.chosen_root = system_id
        self.is_done = True

        total_time = int(time.time() * 1000) - self.start_time

        for sid, card in self.cards.items():
            inspect_btn = self.inspect_buttons[sid]
            mark_btn = self.mark_buttons[sid]
            inspect_btn.setEnabled(False)
            mark_btn.setEnabled(False)
            if sid == system_id:
                mark_btn.setText("✓ علت انتخاب‌شده")
                card.setStyleSheet(self._card_style_marked(sid))

        system = next(
            (s for s in self.systems if s["id"] == system_id),
            None,
        )
        if system is None:
            return

        self.status_label.setText(
            f"✓ علت ریشه‌ای انتخاب‌شده: {system['name']}"
        )
        self.status_label.setStyleSheet(
            "color: #4CAF50; padding: 4px; font-weight: bold;"
        )

        result = {
            "chosen_root_cause": system_id,
            "systems_investigated": list(self.investigated),
            "investigation_times_ms": dict(
                self.investigation_times
            ),
            "time_to_first_action_ms": self.time_to_first_action,
            "total_time_ms": total_time,
            "total_investigated": len(self.investigated),
            "total_systems": len(self.systems),
            "perseveration_count": self.perseveration_count,
        }

        print(f"   [DEBUG] تشخیص نهایی: {result}")
        self.diagnosis_done.emit(result)

        self.skip_btn.setToolTip("پرش به پایان این دیالوگ (کلید S)")
        self.skip_btn.clicked.connect(self._on_skip_clicked)
        bottom_row.addWidget(self.skip_btn)

        dialogue_layout.addLayout(bottom_row)

        main_layout.addWidget(dialogue_frame, stretch=1)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_skip_clicked(self):
        """پرش فوری به پایان دیالوگ جاری"""
        self.typing_timer.stop()
        self.char_index = len(self.full_text)
        self.current_text = self.full_text
        self.text_label.setText(self.current_text)
        self.continue_label.setVisible(True)
        self.skip_btn.setVisible(False)

        if self.data_logger is not None:
            try:
                self.data_logger.log_event(
                    scene_id="dialogue",
                    scenario_id="dialogue_skip",
                    event_type="skip_used",
                    metadata={
                        "speaker": self.speaker_name,
                        "text_length": len(self.full_text),
                    }
                )
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ خطا در log_event برای skip: {e}")

    def show_dialogue(self, speaker_name: str, text: str,
                      portrait_path: Optional[str] = None,
                      emotion: Optional[str] = None):
        self.speaker_name = speaker_name
        self.full_text = text
        self.portrait_path = portrait_path
        self.char_index = 0
        self.current_text = ""

        self.speaker_label.setText(speaker_name)
        self.text_label.setText("")
        self.continue_label.setVisible(False)

        from core.character_registry import get_character
        char = get_character(speaker_name)
        char_color = char.get("color", "#4FC3F7")

        # ✅ تشخیص راوی
        is_narrator = (
            char.get("key") == "narrator"
            or speaker_name in ("راوی", "narrator")
        )

        self.speaker_label.setStyleSheet(f"""
            QLabel {{
                color: {char_color};
                padding-right: 5px;
                background: transparent;
            }}
        """)

        self._update_glossary(text)

        # ✅ اگر راوی است، از تنظیم پرتره صرف‌نظر کن
        if is_narrator:
            self.portrait_label.setVisible(False)
            # ✅ متن روایت کمی متفاوت از دیالوگ شخصیت‌ها
            self.text_label.setStyleSheet("""
                QLabel {
                    color: #E8E8E8;
                    padding-right: 5px;
                    background: transparent;
                }
            """)
            self.skip_btn.setVisible(True)
            
            # ✅ بررسی حالت سریع برای راوی
            from core.app_config import get_fast_mode
            if get_fast_mode():
                self.char_index = len(text)
                self.current_text = text
                self.text_label.setText(self._format_html(text))
                self.continue_label.setVisible(True)
                self.skip_btn.setVisible(False)
            else:
                self.typing_timer.start(self.typing_speed)
            return

        # برای شخصیت‌ها، استایل پیش‌فرض برمی‌گردد
        self.text_label.setStyleSheet("""
            QLabel {
                color: #FFFFFF;
                padding-right: 5px;
                background: transparent;
            }
        """)

        # از این نقطه به بعد، گوینده شخصیت است
        self.portrait_label.setVisible(True)

        # ✅ تعیین emotion: اول override، بعد تشخیص از متن
        from core.character_registry import (
            get_character,
            detect_emotion,
            resolve_portrait_path,
        )
        char = get_character(speaker_name)

        if emotion:
            # ✅ اگر صریح داده شده، از آن استفاده کن
            final_emotion = emotion
        else:
            # ✅ در غیر این صورت، از متن تشخیص بده
            final_emotion = detect_emotion(text)

        # ✅ تعیین مسیر پرتره
        if portrait_path:
            auto_path = portrait_path
        else:
            auto_path = resolve_portrait_path(char, final_emotion)

        self.portrait_label.setFixedSize(180, 180)
        self.portrait_label.set_character(
            char, final_emotion, auto_path
        )

        self.skip_btn.setVisible(True)

        # ✅ حالت سریع: نمایش فوری متن بدون تایپ
        from core.app_config import get_fast_mode
        if get_fast_mode():
            self.char_index = len(text)
            self.current_text = text
            self.text_label.setText(self._format_html(text))
            self.continue_label.setVisible(True)
            self.skip_btn.setVisible(False)
        else:
            self.typing_timer.start(self.typing_speed)

    def _update_glossary(self, text: str):
        self._glossary_terms_in_text = []
        for term, definition in GLOSSARY.items():
            if term in text:
                self._glossary_terms_in_text.append((term, definition))

        self.glossary_btn.setVisible(bool(self._glossary_terms_in_text))

    def _show_glossary(self):
        if not self._glossary_terms_in_text:
            return
        lines = []
        for term, definition in self._glossary_terms_in_text:
            lines.append(f"◆ {term}\n   {definition}")
        msg = QMessageBox(self)
        msg.setWindowTitle("واژه‌های تخصصی")
        msg.setText("\n\n".join(lines))
        msg.setIcon(QMessageBox.Icon.Information)
        msg.setLayoutDirection(Qt.LayoutDirection.RightToLeft)
        msg.exec()

    def _type_next_char(self):
        if self.char_index < len(self.full_text):
            self.char_index += 1
            self.current_text = self.full_text[:self.char_index]
            # ✅ استفاده از HTML برای line-height بهتر
            self.text_label.setText(
                self._format_html(self.current_text)
            )
        else:
            self.typing_timer.stop()
            # ✅ اتمام تایپ — قالب نهایی با line-height کامل
            self.text_label.setText(
                self._format_html(self.full_text)
            )
            self.continue_label.setVisible(True)

    def _format_html(self, text: str) -> str:
        """
        قالب‌بندی HTML برای متن دیالوگ با line-height بهتر.
        کاراکترهای خاص را escape می‌کند.
        """
        # escape کاراکترهای HTML
        safe = (
            text.replace("&", "&amp;")
                .replace("<", "&lt;")
                .replace(">", "&gt;")
        )
        # تبدیل \n به <br>
        safe = safe.replace("\n", "<br>")
        return (
            f'<div style="line-height: 170%; '
            f'color: #FFFFFF;">{safe}</div>'
        )

    def advance(self) -> bool:
        """اگر در حال تایپ بود، متن را کامل می‌کند و False برمی‌گرداند.
        اگر تایپ تمام شده بود، True برمی‌گرداند (یعنی caller پیشروی کند)."""
        if self.typing_timer.isActive():
            self.typing_timer.stop()
            self.char_index = len(self.full_text)
            self.current_text = self.full_text
            self.text_label.setText(
                self._format_html(self.full_text)
            )
            self.continue_label.setVisible(True)
            self.skip_btn.setVisible(False)
            return False
        return True

    def is_typing(self) -> bool:
        return self.typing_timer.isActive()

    def is_complete(self) -> bool:
        return (self.char_index >= len(self.full_text)
                and not self.typing_timer.isActive())

    def clear(self):
        self.typing_timer.stop()
        self.speaker_label.setText("")
        self.text_label.setText("")
        self.portrait_label.set_character({}, "neutral", None)
        self.continue_label.setVisible(False)
        self.glossary_btn.setVisible(False)
        self._glossary_terms_in_text = []
        self.char_index = 0
        self.current_text = ""
        self.full_text = ""

    def mousePressEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        """کلیک روی هرجای کادر دیالوگ = پیشروی"""
        if event.button() == Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton:
            self.advanced.emit()
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

// File: truthline_pyqt/widgets/glitch_overlay.py

"""
افکت Glitch برای انتقال بین فازها
====================================
- چند نوار افقی رنگی که به‌سرعت ظاهر و ناپدید می‌شوند
- بدون تداخل با کلیک
- ۵۰۰ میلی‌ثانیه طول می‌کشد

نسخه: 1.0.0
"""
import random
import math
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer, QRectF
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPainter, QColor, QBrush


class GlitchOverlay(QWidget):
    """لایه‌ی Glitch که به‌طور موقت نمایش داده می‌شود"""

    def __init__(self, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        self.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground, True
        )
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent; border: none;")

        self._bands: list = []
        self._elapsed = 0
        self._duration = 500   # ms
        self._active = False
        self._accent = QColor("#4FC3F7")

        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._tick)

    def start(self, duration_ms: int = 500,
              color: str = "#4FC3F7"):
        """شروع افکت glitch"""
        self._accent = QColor(color)
        self._duration = duration_ms
        self._elapsed = 0
        self._active = True
        self._bands = []

        # ✅ ساخت نوارهای رنگی
        n_bands = 12
        for i in range(n_bands):
            self._bands.append({
                "y": random.random(),
                "height": random.uniform(2, 8),
                "color": random.choice([
                    self._accent,
                    QColor("#FFFFFF"),
                    QColor(255, 100, 100),
                    QColor(100, 100, 255),
                ]),
                "offset": random.uniform(-0.15, 0.15),
                "alpha": random.randint(80, 200),
            })

        self.show()
        self.raise_()
        self._timer.start(30)

    def _tick(self):
        self._elapsed += 30
        if self._elapsed >= self._duration:
            self._active = False
            self._timer.stop()
            self.hide()
            return
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if not self._active:
            return

        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)

        w = self.width()
        h = self.height()

        # ✅ محاسبه‌ی شدت (fade in/out)
        progress = self._elapsed / self._duration
        if progress < 0.3:
            intensity = progress / 0.3
        elif progress < 0.7:
            intensity = 1.0
        else:
            intensity = 1.0 - (progress - 0.7) / 0.3

        for band in self._bands:
            y = band["y"] * h
            bh = band["height"]
            offset = band["offset"] * w * math.sin(
                self._elapsed * 0.05
            )

            color = QColor(band["color"])
            a = int(band["alpha"] * intensity)
            color.setAlpha(max(0, min(255, a)))

            painter.setBrush(QBrush(color))
            painter.drawRect(
                QRectF(offset, y, w, bh)
            )

        # ✅ نویز نقطه‌ای
        for _ in range(40):
            x = random.random() * w
            y = random.random() * h
            a = int(random.randint(30, 120) * intensity)
            painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(255, 255, 255, a)))
            painter.drawRect(int(x), int(y), 2, 2)

        painter.end()

// File: truthline_pyqt/widgets/global_click_filter.py

"""
فیلتر سراسری صدای کلیک — روی همه‌ی QPushButton ها
====================================================
با نصب این فیلتر روی QApplication، هر کلیک روی هر دکمه‌ای
در هر صحنه، صدای کلیک را پخش می‌کند.

نسخه: 1.0.1 — نام پارامترها با کلاس پایه QObject سازگار شد
"""
from PyQt6.QtCore import QObject, QEvent
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QPushButton


class GlobalClickSoundFilter(QObject):
    """فیلتر سراسری برای صدای کلیک"""

    # ✅ نام پارامترها دقیقاً مثل کلاس پایه QObject
    def eventFilter(self, a0, a1):  # type: ignore[override]
        # a0 = obj (ویجت هدف), a1 = event (رویداد)
        try:
            if a1 is not None and a1.type() == QEvent.Type.MouseButtonRelease:
                if isinstance(a0, QPushButton):
                    if a0.isEnabled():
                        from core.audio_manager import (
                            get_audio_manager
                        )
                        get_audio_manager().play_sfx("click")
        except Exception:
            pass

        return super().eventFilter(a0, a1)


def install_global_click_filter(app):
    """نصب فیلتر روی QApplication"""
    global _filter_instance
    try:
        _filter_instance = GlobalClickSoundFilter(app)
        app.installEventFilter(_filter_instance)
        print("✓ GlobalClickSoundFilter نصب شد")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"⚠️ خطا در نصب فیلتر صدای کلیک: {e}")


# نگه‌داری مرجع قوی
_filter_instance = None

class HUDWidget(QWidget):

        self.save_timer = QTimer()
        self.save_timer.timeout.connect(self._hide_save_indicator)

        self._dim_overlay: QFrame | None = None

        self._setup_ui()
        self._setup_dim_overlay()

    # ================================================================
    def _setup_dim_overlay(self):
        """ساخت لایه‌ی نیمه‌شفاف برای حالت کم‌رنگ"""
        overlay = QFrame(self)
        overlay.setStyleSheet("""
            QFrame {
                background-color: rgba(11, 29, 58, 0.55);
                border: none;
            }
        """)
        overlay.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        overlay.setGeometry(self.rect())
        overlay.hide()
        self._dim_overlay = overlay

    def resizeEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        super().resizeEvent(event)
        if self._dim_overlay is not None:
            self._dim_overlay.setGeometry(self.rect())
            if self._dim_overlay.isVisible():
                self._dim_overlay.raise_()

    # ================================================================
    def set_dimmed(self, dimmed: bool):
        """
        حالت کم‌رنگ با overlay ساده (بدون QGraphicsEffect).
            dimmed=True  → HUD کم‌رنگ
            dimmed=False → HUD پررنگ
        """
        if self._dim_overlay is None:
            return
        if dimmed:
            self._dim_overlay.setGeometry(self.rect())
            self._dim_overlay.raise_()
            self._dim_overlay.show()
        else:
            self._dim_overlay.hide()

        self.objective_label.setText(objective_text)

        self.scenario_label.setText(f"{current} / {total}")
        self.scenario_frame.setVisible(True)

    def hide_scenario_progress(self):
        self.scenario_frame.setVisible(False)

        self.phase_label.setStyleSheet(f"QLabel {{ color: {color}; }}")

        self.is_saving = False
        self.save_timer.stop()

        try:
            main_window = self.window()
            open_log = getattr(main_window, "_open_mission_log", None)
            if callable(open_log):
                open_log()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ خطا در باز کردن دفترچه: {e}")

        try:
            main_window = self.window()
            open_dossier = getattr(
                main_window, "_open_character_dossier", None
            )
            if callable(open_dossier):
                open_dossier()
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ خطا در باز کردن پرونده: {e}")

    # ================================================================
    def record_decision(self, quality: float, label: str = ""):
        if not SHOW_DECISION_TRAIL:
            return
        self.trail_widget.mark_next()
        if not self.trail_frame.isVisible():
            self.trail_frame.setVisible(True)

    def reset_trail(self):
        self.trail_widget.reset()
        self.trail_frame.setVisible(False)

    def set_progress_from_scenario(self, phase_key: str,
                                     current: int, total_in_phase: int):
        phase_order = ["phase1", "phase2", "phase3", "phase4", "hexaco"]
        if phase_key not in phase_order:
            return
        phase_index = phase_order.index(phase_key)
        total_phases = len(phase_order)
        phase_weight = 100.0 / total_phases
        in_phase_pct = (
            (current / max(1, total_in_phase)) if total_in_phase > 0 else 0.0
        )
        total_pct = int(
            phase_index * phase_weight + in_phase_pct * phase_weight
        )
        self.progress_label.setText(f"پیشرفت مأموریت: {total_pct}٪")
        self.progress_bar.setValue(total_pct)

    def initialize_decision_trail(self, total_scenarios: int):
        if not SHOW_DECISION_TRAIL:
            return
        self.trail_widget.set_total(total_scenarios)
        self.trail_frame.setVisible(True)

// File: truthline_pyqt/widgets/loading_overlay.py

"""
نمایشگر بارگذاری (Loading Overlay)
=====================================
- یک دایره‌ی چرخان در وسط صفحه
- لایه‌ی نیمه‌شفاف روی پس‌زمینه
- بدون مسدود کردن کلیک (اختیاری: مسدودکننده)

نسخه: 1.0.0
"""
import math
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import (
    QWidget, QLabel, QVBoxLayout, QGraphicsOpacityEffect
)
from PyQt6.QtCore import (
    Qt, QTimer, QPropertyAnimation, QEasingCurve
)
from PyQt6.QtGui import (
    QPainter, QPen, QColor, QFont, QBrush
)

FONT_FAMILY = "Vazirmatn"


class LoadingOverlay(QWidget):
    """
    لایه‌ی بارگذاری — روی parent قرار می‌گیرد و چرخاننده
    نشان می‌دهد.
    """

    def __init__(self, parent=None, message: str = "لطفاً صبر کنید..."):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._message = message
        self._angle = 0.0
        self._active = False

        # ✅ تنظیمات ظاهری
        self.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_StyledBackground, False
        )
        self.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground, True
        )
        self.setStyleSheet(
            "background: transparent; border: none;"
        )
        self.hide()

        # ✅ تایمر انیمیشن
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._tick)
        self._timer.setInterval(40)

        # ✅ اگر parent یک QWidget است، هم‌اندازه شو
        parent_widget = self.parentWidget()
        if parent_widget is not None:
            self.setGeometry(parent_widget.rect())
            self.raise_()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def start(self, message: str | None = None):
        """شروع نمایش"""
        if message is not None:
            self._message = message
        self._active = True
        parent_widget = self.parentWidget()
        if parent_widget is not None:
            self.setGeometry(parent_widget.rect())
        self.show()
        self.raise_()
        self._timer.start()

    def stop(self):
        """پایان نمایش"""
        self._active = False
        self._timer.stop()
        self.hide()

    def set_message(self, text: str):
        self._message = text
        self.update()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _tick(self):
        self._angle = (self._angle + 8) % 360
        self.update()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if not self._active:
            return

        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)

        w = self.width()
        h = self.height()
        cx = w / 2
        cy = h / 2

        # پس‌زمینه‌ی نیمه‌شفاف
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)
        painter.setBrush(QBrush(QColor(11, 29, 58, 200)))
        painter.drawRect(0, 0, w, h)

        # حلقه‌ی چرخان
        radius = 36
        pen_width = 6

        # حلقه‌ی پس‌زمینه
        painter.setPen(QPen(
            QColor(43, 74, 111, 180), pen_width
        ))
        painter.setBrush(Qt.BrushStyle.NoBrush)
        painter.drawEllipse(
            int(cx - radius), int(cy - radius),
            radius * 2, radius * 2,
        )

        # قوس چرخان
        painter.setPen(QPen(
            QColor("#4FC3F7"), pen_width,
            Qt.PenStyle.SolidLine, Qt.PenCapStyle.RoundCap,
        ))
        start_angle = int(self._angle * 16)
        span_angle = int(90 * 16)  # ۹۰ درجه
        rect = (
            int(cx - radius), int(cy - radius),
            radius * 2, radius * 2,
        )
        painter.drawArc(*rect, start_angle, span_angle)

        # متن
        painter.setPen(QColor("#FFFFFF"))
        painter.setFont(QFont(FONT_FAMILY, 13, QFont.Weight.Bold))
        text_rect = (
            int(cx - 200), int(cy + radius + 20),
            400, 30,
        )
        painter.drawText(
            text_rect[0], text_rect[1],
            text_rect[2], text_rect[3],
            int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter),
            self._message,
        )

        painter.end()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def mousePressEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        # جلوگیری از کلیک‌های ناخواسته در حین بارگذاری
        if self._active:
            event.accept()
            return
        super().mousePressEvent(event)

// File: truthline_pyqt/widgets/parallax_layer.py

"""
لایه‌ی پارالاکس برای منو
==========================
- چند لایه‌ی دکوراتیو که با سرعت‌های متفاوت حرکت می‌کنند
- بدون تداخل با کلیک (transparent for mouse)
- کاملاً رویه‌ای — بدون تصویر

نسخه: 1.0.0
"""
import random
import math
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer, QPointF
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPainter, QColor, QBrush, QPen


class ParallaxLayer(QWidget):
    """لایه‌ی پارالاکس با اشیاء شناور"""

    def __init__(self, depth: int = 1, parent=None):
        """
        depth: 1 = نزدیک (سریع، بزرگ)، 3 = دور (کند، کوچک)
        """
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.depth = max(1, min(3, depth))

        self.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        self.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground, True
        )
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent; border: none;")

        # ✅ پارامترها بر اساس عمق
        self.speed = 0.6 / self.depth
        self.opacity = {1: 90, 2: 60, 3: 35}[self.depth]
        self.size_min = {1: 2.0, 2: 1.2, 3: 0.8}[self.depth]
        self.size_max = {1: 3.5, 2: 2.2, 3: 1.4}[self.depth]
        self.count = {1: 12, 2: 20, 3: 30}[self.depth]

        self._phase = 0.0
        self._shapes: list = []
        self._regenerate()

        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._tick)
        self._timer.start(70)

    def _regenerate(self):
        self._shapes = []
        for _ in range(self.count):
            self._shapes.append({
                "x": random.random(),
                "y": random.random(),
                "size": random.uniform(
                    self.size_min, self.size_max
                ),
                "vx": random.uniform(-0.15, 0.15),
                "vy": random.uniform(-0.25, -0.05),
                "phase": random.uniform(0, 6.28),
                "shape": random.choice(
                    ["circle", "circle", "square"]
                ),
            })

    def _tick(self):
        self._phase += 0.03
        if self._phase > 2 * math.pi:
            self._phase -= 2 * math.pi
        for s in self._shapes:
            s["x"] += s["vx"] * self.speed * 0.008
            s["y"] += s["vy"] * self.speed * 0.008
            # wrap
            if s["y"] < -0.05:
                s["y"] = 1.05
                s["x"] = random.random()
            if s["y"] > 1.05:
                s["y"] = -0.05
            if s["x"] < -0.05:
                s["x"] = 1.05
            if s["x"] > 1.05:
                s["x"] = -0.05
        self.update()

    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if not self._shapes:
            return

        painter = QPainter(self)
        painter.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)

        w = self.width()
        h = self.height()

        for s in self._shapes:
            x = s["x"] * w
            y = s["y"] * h
            size = s["size"]

            # ✅ ضربان شفافیت
            pulse = (math.sin(
                s["phase"] + self._phase * 0.5
            ) + 1) * 0.5
            alpha = int(self.opacity * (0.6 + 0.4 * pulse))

            color = QColor(79, 195, 247, alpha)
            painter.setBrush(QBrush(color))

            if s["shape"] == "square":
                painter.drawRect(
                    int(x - size), int(y - size),
                    int(size * 2), int(size * 2)
                )
            else:
                painter.drawEllipse(QPointF(x, y), size, size)

        painter.end()

"""
لایه‌ی ذرات رویه‌ای (Procedural Particles)
==========================================
- ذرات کوچک شناور روی پس‌زمینه
- بدون نیاز به کلیک (transparent for mouse events)
- تم اختصاصی برای هر فاز
- کارایی بالا با QTimer

نسخه: 1.0.0
"""
import random
from PyQt6.QtWidgets import QWidget
from PyQt6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer, QPointF
from PyQt6.QtGui import QPainter, QColor, QBrush, QPen


# ============================================================
# تم ذرات برای هر صحنه
# ============================================================
PARTICLE_THEMES = {
    "phase1": {
        "color": "#4FC3F7",
        "count": 40,
        "speed": 0.35,
        "size_range": (1.5, 3.5),
        "alpha_range": (60, 160),
        "shape": "circle",
    },
    "phase2": {
        "color": "#FF8F00",
        "count": 35,
        "speed": 0.5,
        "size_range": (1.0, 2.8),
        "alpha_range": (70, 180),
        "shape": "circle",
    },
    "phase3": {
        "color": "#9C27B0",
        "count": 50,
        "speed": 0.25,
        "size_range": (1.2, 3.0),
        "alpha_range": (60, 150),
        "shape": "square",
    },
    "phase4": {
        "color": "#D32F2F",
        "count": 20,
        "speed": 0.15,
        "size_range": (1.8, 3.5),
        "alpha_range": (50, 130),
        "shape": "circle",
    },
    "night": {
        "color": "#B0BEC5",
        "count": 15,
        "speed": 0.08,
        "size_range": (1.0, 2.5),
        "alpha_range": (80, 200),
        "shape": "circle",
    },
    "default": {
        "color": "#4FC3F7",
        "count": 25,
        "speed": 0.25,
        "size_range": (1.5, 3.0),
        "alpha_range": (60, 150),
        "shape": "circle",
    },
}


class ParticleOverlay(QWidget):
    """لایه‌ی ذرات — روی پس‌زمینه، بدون مسدود کردن کلیک"""

    def __init__(self, theme_key: str = "default", parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)

        # ✅ ذرات نباید کلیک را مسدود کنند
        self.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TransparentForMouseEvents, True
        )
        self.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_TranslucentBackground, True
        )
        self.setAttribute(
            Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_StyledBackground, False
        )
        self.setStyleSheet("background: transparent; border: none;")

        self._theme = PARTICLE_THEMES.get(
            theme_key, PARTICLE_THEMES["default"]
        )
        self._particles: list = []
        self._generate_particles()

        # ✅ تایمر برای به‌روزرسانی موقعیت
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self._tick)
        self._timer.start(60)  # ~16 FPS — کارایی بهتر

        # ✅ اگر ویجت خالی بود، یک‌بار resize کنیم
        self.resize(800, 600)

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    def _generate_particles(self):
        """تولید ذرات با ویژگی‌های تصادفی"""
        self._particles.clear()
        count = self._theme["count"]
        size_min, size_max = self._theme["size_range"]
        alpha_min, alpha_max = self._theme["alpha_range"]

        for _ in range(count):
            self._particles.append({
                "x": random.random(),
                "y": random.random(),
                "size": random.uniform(size_min, size_max),
                "alpha": random.randint(alpha_min, alpha_max),
                "vx": random.uniform(-0.2, 0.2),
                "vy": random.uniform(-0.4, -0.05),
                "phase": random.uniform(0, 6.28),  # برای موج
            })

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    def _tick(self):
        """به‌روزرسانی موقعیت ذرات"""
        speed = self._theme["speed"]
        for p in self._particles:
            p["x"] += p["vx"] * speed * 0.01
            p["y"] += p["vy"] * speed * 0.01
            p["phase"] += 0.05

            # wrap
            if p["y"] < -0.05:
                p["y"] = 1.05
                p["x"] = random.random()
            if p["y"] > 1.05:
                p["y"] = -0.05
            if p["x"] < -0.05:
                p["x"] = 1.05
            if p["x"] > 1.05:
                p["x"] = -0.05

        self.update()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    def paintEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        if not self._particles:
            return

        painter = QPainter(self)
        if not painter.isActive():
            return

        try:
            painter.setRenderHint(
                QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing
            )
            painter.setPen(Qt.PenStyle.NoPen)

            w = self.width()
            h = self.height()
            if w < 10 or h < 10:
                return

            base_color = QColor(self._theme["color"])
            shape = self._theme["shape"]

            for p in self._particles:
                x = p["x"] * w
                y = p["y"] * h
                size = p["size"]

                import math
                pulse = (math.sin(p["phase"]) + 1.0) * 0.5
                alpha = int(
                    p["alpha"] * (0.7 + 0.3 * pulse)
                )
                alpha = max(0, min(255, alpha))

                c = QColor(
                    base_color.red(),
                    base_color.green(),
                    base_color.blue(),
                    alpha,
                )
                painter.setBrush(QBrush(c))

                if shape == "square":
                    painter.drawRect(
                        int(x - size / 2),
                        int(y - size / 2),
                        int(size),
                        int(size),
                    )
                else:
                    painter.drawEllipse(
                        QPointF(x, y), size, size
                    )
        finally:
            try:
                painter.end()
            except Exception:
                pass

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    def set_theme(self, theme_key: str):
        """تغییر تم ذرات"""
        self._theme = PARTICLE_THEMES.get(
            theme_key, PARTICLE_THEMES["default"]
        )
        self._generate_particles()
        self.update()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------
    def stop(self):
        """توقف تایمر — هنگام پنهان شدن"""
        self._timer.stop()

    def start(self):
        """شروع مجدد تایمر"""
        if not self._timer.isActive():
            self._timer.start(60)

    # ✅ مدیریت خودکار تایمر بر اساس نمایش/پنهان شدن
    def showEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        super().showEvent(event)
        if not self._timer.isActive():
            self._timer.start(60)

    def hideEvent(self, event):  # type: ignore
        super().hideEvent(event)
        if self._timer.isActive():
            self._timer.stop()
